title: AI Creative Producer, Vertical Drama
description:
**About Zing** 




 We are a fast\-growing digital entertainment company specializing in high\-quality vertical miniseries and UGC ads for global audiences. Through innovative storytelling and audience\-driven approaches, we aim to captivate mobile\-first viewers with fast\-paced, engaging, and emotionally compelling content. Our mission is to redefine short\-form entertainment by integrating creativity, data\-driven insights, and cross\-cultural perspectives.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The AI Creative Producer, Vertical Drama owns both the creative and operational success of Zing's AI\-produced vertical drama slate, end to end. This is a hybrid director/producer role: you set the visual and storytelling direction for each series, and you also run the vendor relationships, timelines, budgets, and delivery process that get it made. You are the single point of accountability between Zing's leadership and its external AI production partners — translating scripts into production\-ready creative direction, briefing and managing AI vendors, reviewing every stage of delivery for both creative quality and operational compliance, and making sure episodes ship on time, on budget, and on brand.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Creative Direction**



* Lead AI\-powered vertical short drama projects from script breakdown through final delivery.
* Translate scripts into production\-ready visual plans: scene breakdowns, shot lists, character references, location references, style guides, and AI production requirements.
* Guide AI image and video generation; review style frames, character tests, motion tests, rough cuts, and final deliverables, and give clear, actionable notes on continuity, performance, composition, pacing, and tone.
* Strengthen episode\-level hooks, cliffhangers, reversals, and emotional escalation for 1–3 minute vertical episodes.
* Maintain visual, character, and story consistency across episodes and series.
* Supervise post\-production — editing, sound, music, subtitles, and final polish.



**Production \& Vendor Management**



* Serve as the primary point of contact between Zing and external AI production vendors and partners.
* Own project timelines, budgets, and resource/vendor allocation across multiple concurrent productions.
* Communicate creative briefs, visual references, production standards, delivery timelines, and revision notes to vendors, and hold them to Zing's technical specs (9:16 format, 1–3 min episodes) and quality benchmarks.
* Manage legal and logistical documentation, including contracts, deliverables, and release forms.
* Identify production risks, bottlenecks, and vendor concerns; propose mitigations and escalate to leadership as needed.
* Enforce SOP compliance across all productions and proactively build relationships with new top\-tier AI production vendors.



**Systems \& Continuous Improvement**



* Build repeatable AI production workflows: vendor briefing templates, character bibles, prompt guidelines, review checklists, and delivery specifications.
* Translate platform data, audience feedback, and ad performance learnings into creative and production improvements.
* Help define Zing's internal AI vertical drama production playbook and quality standards.
* Monitor emerging AI tools, trends, and vendor capabilities to keep Zing's workflows and partner network competitive.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in vertical/short\-form drama production — as a director, showrunner, creative producer, or producer — with real credits in the format (not adjacent film/TV only).
* Direct working experience using AI creative tools specifically for vertical drama production, e.g. Seedance, Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Flux, ComfyUI, Pika, Luma, or similar, in an actual production pipeline (not just personal experimentation).
* Strong understanding of vertical drama structure and mechanics: hooks, reversals, cliffhangers, emotional escalation, fast\-payoff storytelling.



**Also Important** 



* Proven experience managing external vendors, production partners, or outsourced/remote production teams, ideally across several projects at once.
* Strong visual storytelling ability — framing, shot design, blocking, mood, performance direction, edit rhythm — paired with equally strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Comfortable owning budgets, timelines, contracts, and vendor accountability, not just creative notes.
* Strong taste in commercial, female\-driven vertical drama genres: romance, fantasy, revenge, billionaire, werewolf, mafia, forbidden love, melodrama, or similar high\-retention genres.
* Familiarity with production/workflow tools such as Airtable, Notion, or Frame.io.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable managing multiple stakeholders (leadership, vendors, AI artists) at once.
* Fluent English required; Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus for coordinating with overseas AI production partners.
* Must be based in or able to work from Los Angeles.
* A portfolio or work sample — director reels, vendor briefs, visual lookbooks, storyboards, or produced vertical series — is strongly preferred.

title: Creative Director- Interior Design
description:
1\.1 The Creative Director is the custodian of EVA Interiors’ creative vision, design quality, and aesthetic integrity across all interior design, architectural, and FF\&E outputs.
 



 1\.2 The role exists to institutionalize creativity at EVA Interiors by transforming creative vision into clear standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency, excellence, and repeatable quality at scale.
 



 1\.3 The Creative Director ensures that EVA’s creative output reflects a luxury positioning that is innovative, disciplined, commercially viable, and execution\-ready, while continuously evolving to remain relevant and distinctive in the market.
 



  





**2\.1 Creative Vision, Guidelines \& Governance** 



* The Creative Director defines, documents, and continuously refines EVA Interiors’ creative philosophy and design language, ensuring that spatial principles, material hierarchy, detailing standards, colour strategies, and FF\&E integration are formalised within approved governance frameworks.
* The role ensures that all creative outputs demonstrably comply with documented standards, and that any deviation is formally identified, evaluated, and addressed through structured corrective governance mechanisms rather than informal tolerance.
* The Creative Director maintains executive oversight of all design\-related SOPs to ensure sustained alignment between creative integrity, structured workflows, and disciplined project execution.
* Creative standards shall be applied consistently across all projects and shall be subject to continuous refinement informed by documented review outcomes, performance analysis, and institutional learning.



**2\.2 Measurable Creative Output \& First Time\-Right Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative leadership translates into measurable, predictable, and disciplined quality outcomes.
* A minimum first\-submission approval rate of (80%) shall be maintained across formal design reviews, unless deviations are supported by documented root cause analysis and clearly defined corrective action plans.
* Review cycles shall remain within agreed revision thresholds. Recurrent rework patterns shall trigger structured evaluation, accountability review, and systemic improvement measures rather than normalization.
* All scheduled creative reviews constitute mandatory leadership obligations. Attendance shall be maintained consistently. In cases of unavoidable absence, formal delegation of documented decision authority shall be established in advance. Any missed review shall require written explanation and rescheduling within (24\) hours.
* Approvals, rejections, and required design modifications shall be communicated within agreed review timelines to prevent avoidable production delays or adverse impact on project revenue realization, forecast integrity, or client confidence.
* Review feedback and formal approval decisions shall be issued within (24\) hours of the review session unless otherwise formally justified in writing.
* Creative authority within EVA shall operate as a performance accelerator and governance safeguard, never as a constraint on disciplined production.



**2\.3 Structured Review Cadence \& Institutional Discipline** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for maintaining a defined, documented, and consistently executed creative governance rhythm across the organization.
* At minimum, one structured Creative Review session shall be led weekly, and one formal Quality Retrospective shall be conducted monthly. Each session shall produce documented minutes, clearly assigned accountability, and tracked follow\-up actions.
* Recurring quality deviations, review inefficiencies, or creative inconsistencies shall be translated into updated guidelines, strengthened enforcement protocols, or revised governance standards.
* Creative governance within EVA shall be cyclical, documented, and continuously reinforced to ensure institutional maturity and sustained quality performance.



**2\.4 Commercial Alignment \& Revenue Protection** 



* The Creative Director is accountable for ensuring that creative decisions are aligned with approved project timelines, revenue realization schedules, forecast commitments, and overall project profitability.
* The Creative Director shall collaborate with Planning and Operations to ensure that creative timelines and review cycles are realistically reflected in revenue forecasts, milestone commitments, and execution sequencing.
* Creative refinement shall not introduce avoidable delays that negatively affect revenue progression, cash flow timing, forecast accuracy, or client confidence.
* Where creative ambition presents potential timeline, cost, or commercial exposure, such implications shall be proactively identified, formally evaluated, and resolved in coordination with project leadership and Executive Management.
* Design excellence within EVA is expected to unlock commercial value while preserving disciplined control over schedule, cost, and revenue integrity.



**2\.5 Escalation \& Risk Management Obligation** 



* Any creative, quality, review\-related, or design governance issue that may materially impact project timelines, revenue realization, client confidence, or brand reputation shall be escalated to Executive Management within (24\) hours.
* Escalation shall include a documented impact assessment, root cause analysis, and proposed mitigation strategy.
* No material creative risk shall remain unaddressed, undocumented, or without executive visibility.



**2\.6 Enforcement Authority \& Team Performance Accountability** 



* The Creative Director is responsible for enforcing compliance with approved design standards, governance frameworks, and review discipline across all design personnel.
* Where repeated non\-compliance, quality deviation, review absence, or execution inconsistency occurs, the Creative Director shall initiate structured corrective action in coordination with Executive Management and Human Resources.
* Delegation of responsibilities does not eliminate accountability for creative outcomes. Enforcement authority is inherent to the role and integral to its seniority, Sustained failure to meet defined governance cadence, revision thresholds, escalation timelines, or documented enforcement obligations shall constitute performance non\-compliance and shall be subject to formal performance review in accordance with company policy.



**2\.7 Innovation \& Strategic Creative Development** 



* The Creative Director leads structured innovation initiatives designed to enhance differentiation, strengthen quality standards, and improve execution efficiency.
* Innovation must be practical, buildable, commercially responsible, and clearly linked to brand positioning or project value.
* Creative experimentation must be governed, documented, and selectively integrated into live projects where appropriate.



**2\.8 FF\&E Library Governance \& Design Asset Control** 



* The Creative Director holds strategic ownership of EVA’s FF\&E Library and ensures that it remains curated, quality\-controlled, commercially viable, and aligned with EVA’s luxury positioning.
* All additions shall meet defined standards of originality, feasibility, execution readiness, and brand coherence.
* The FF\&E Library shall function as an active production, quality\-control, and creative governance asset supporting consistency and efficiency across projects.



**2\.9 Leadership Presence \& Accessibility** 



* The Creative Director is expected to maintain consistent on\-site leadership presence during critical review cycles, high\-visibility project phases, and production\-intensive periods.
* Leadership availability and accessibility are structural expectations of the role. Remote work arrangements shall not compromise review cadence, enforcement discipline, team accessibility, or executive responsiveness and require formal approval in accordance with company policy.
* Creative leadership within EVA requires visible authority, sustained engagement, and operational presence commensurate with the seniority of the role.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
 Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.
   

  

 We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.
   

  

 Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!
   

  

 Check out our
 **Careers** 
 page for more about working at Circle.
   

  

**About The Role**
**We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.**
 This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.
   

  

 We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.
   

  

 You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.
   

  

 As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in\-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.
   

  

**Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Shape Circle’s narrative. Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long\-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.
* Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns. Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.
* Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio. You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co\-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high\-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.
* Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns. Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high\-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media\-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.
* Direct how our stories come to life across video and events. Get hands\-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.
* Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision. This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.
* Turn partnerships into stories. Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.


**What We're Looking For**
* A body of work you’re genuinely proud of. We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.
* Exceptional creative taste and judgment. You know great work when you see it, can articulate why it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. Just as importantly, you know when an idea is trying too hard, when something is off\-brand, and when your own fingerprints are making the work worse rather than better.
* You’re an exceptional storyteller and writer. You can take something complicated and find the simple, compelling story inside it. You care deeply about language and will happily obsess over a headline, a launch narrative, or a single line of copy until it feels inevitable.
* A strong point of view, and the ability to make it better through collaboration. We don’t want someone who waits for a brief and executes it. We want someone who can tell us what the brief should be, challenge the premise when necessary, elevate ideas coming from the team and our founders, and make a compelling case for a different direction.
* Real fluency in video as a creative medium. You don’t need to shoot, edit, animate, or produce. But you should deeply understand what makes video work, from the script and opening seconds to structure, pacing, emotion, and payoff. You should also understand why a great launch film, social video, customer story, and paid ad require very different creative choices.
* Experience making creative that has to perform. You’ve developed ads and campaigns where the work was ultimately accountable to results. You’ve seen the numbers, learned from them, iterated because of them, and know how to partner with paid acquisition teams without allowing performance marketing to turn into boring marketing.
* An instinct for getting attention without going off script. You understand how to make a brand noticeable, surprising, and culturally relevant without chasing attention for its own sake. Ideally, you can show us a creative risk you fought for that worked, and another you talked the room out of because it wasn’t right for the brand.
* The ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy. There’s no large creative organization reporting to you. Much of your impact will come from getting exceptional work out of designers, marketers, writers, video producers, agencies, and founders who don’t report to you. You know how to raise the creative bar without becoming a bottleneck.
* A great eye for design and deep respect for the craft. You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with exceptional ones. Our Design Studio is led by a co\-founder and operates with a very high bar; you’ll need the visual taste, vocabulary, and collaborative instincts to be a trusted creative partner to that team.
* Experience working closely with founders. You’re comfortable working with founders who care deeply about the product, brand, and details. You will need to extract the vision, challenge it when needed, and turn it into something better than either of you would have arrived at independently.
* An obsession with understanding what how to tell the world about we do and why it matters. The best creative work here will come from understanding Circle at a deep level: our product, customers, competitors, category, and where the market is going. You should genuinely enjoy developing that level of context rather than treating it as somebody else’s job.
* Exceptional communication skills. Circle is global, remote, and highly asynchronous. You’ll need outstanding written and verbal English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), and the ability to make your thinking clear enough that great work can move forward even when everyone isn’t in the same room.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
 Circle offers U.S.\-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.
   

  

 We’re a remote\-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.
   

  

****Learn more****
* Candidate Safety \& Interview Process Notice
* Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion
* How We Use Candidate Data
* Equal Employment Opportunity
* Visit our Candidate Hub to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

title: Studio Director
description:
Westside Design, in partnership with Westside Build, is a Santa Monica\-based design and construction firm rebuilding homes across the Pacific Palisades in the wake of the wildfire. We bring architecture, design, and construction under one roof, with a strong emphasis on technology, speed, and craft.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Studio Director** 
 to lead an entire studio across client management, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can operate as a broad\-based leader rather than a narrow specialist, someone who can move between client conversations, project strategy, technical issues, team leadership, and day\-to\-day studio needs with ease.
   

  

 This role is intended to be more of a multi\-tool leadership position: a person who can talk about contracts, deal with clients, guide design, engage technical and CA issues, and help support the Managing Principal lead the full studio. The Studio Director will directly lead our Project Managers and Project Architects, who are responsible for BIM model development, construction documentation, and permit\-ready deliverables in Revit. You will set the design intent and quality bar that the team documents and executes against, review their work at key milestones, and serve as the design authority they escalate to on coordination, code, and client\-facing design decisions.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 13\+ years of professional experience in architecture, residential design\-build, or a comparable studio environment
* 8\+ years leading complex residential projects through design, technical coordination, and delivery
* 5\+ years in a senior leadership role spanning client management, contracts, team oversight, and project execution
* Residential experience, especially custom homes, ADUs, and rebuild work
* Proven ability to lead across contracts, client management, design discussions, technical coordination, and CA
* Strong leadership presence and sound judgment in a fast\-moving environment
* Experience overseeing teams, projects, and multiple stakeholder relationships
* Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively with clients, internal teams, and leadership
* Must bring direct experience in a comparable leadership seat; this is not intended as a step\-up role from PM or senior project architect


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years in a role such as Studio Director, Senior Project Manager, Design Director, or similar leadership role
* Experience in integrated architecture/construction or design\-build settings
* Familiarity with consultant coordination, construction documentation, and field\-related problem solving


**Studio Leadership**
* Lead the overall performance of the studio across client service, project execution, staffing coordination, and day\-to\-day operations
* Serve as a senior leader helping guide studio priorities, unblock issues, and maintain momentum across multiple active projects
* Partner with firm leadership on studio structure, resourcing, and operational effectiveness
* Help create accountability across the studio by following up on open items, pushing decisions forward, and keeping workstreams moving


**Client \& Project Leadership**
* Serve as a senior point of contact for clients and help manage relationships across active work
* Navigate project conversations across scope, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery
* Step into difficult project situations and help resolve issues with sound judgment and a broad understanding of project needs
* Balance design intent, technical requirements, coordination demands, and client expectations across the life of a project


**Contracts, Technical Oversight \& CA**
* Engage directly in contract review, contract language discussions, and related project risk items as needed
* Provide high\-level oversight on technical issues and support teams in resolving project coordination challenges
* Participate in CA\-related discussions and help ensure project issues are being surfaced and addressed appropriately
* Act as a senior escalation point when projects need broader leadership attention beyond pure design questions


**Team Leadership**
* Help supervise and support team members working across design, project delivery, and technical execution
* Provide oversight and direction to staff who need support coordinating clients, internal standards, and changing project demands
* Mentor team members and help reinforce expectations for accountability, communication, and cross\-functional coordination
* Work closely with leadership to identify where additional supervision or stronger management coverage is needed


**Benefits**
* Hybrid work schedule: four days in\-office, one day remote
* Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, and vision)
* Paid time off and holidays
* Professional development opportunities
* A collaborative, innovative work environment with a supportive culture focused on mentorship and growth


***Compensation:***
*Commensurate with experience and scope of leadership responsibility. The salary range for this role is $140,000\-$170,000\.*

title: Senior Director, AI Transformation & Operations
description:
The Senior Director of AI Transformation \& Operations serves as the operational heart of the ELEC AI Center of Excellence.
  

  

This is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for translating our enterprise\-wide AI strategy into reality.
  

  

You will provide the structure, shared foundations, and governance that enable our four business lines to deliver AI solutions with speed, quality, and precision.
**Job Description**
===================


**The mission of the AI Operations Leader within our office is to:**


* **Enable Execution:** Facilitate the execution of Business Line long\-term strategy (LTS) plans, ensuring they move at speed and with high impact.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Define and manage the day\-to\-day mechanisms that deliver consistent quality, ensuring that every AI initiative is executed with discipline and minimal risk.
* **Scale Through Capability:** Act as the operational backbone of our center of excellence, transforming our strategy into repeatable processes that allow our businesses to own and scale their AI delivery effectively.

**What you’ll be doing**


* **Facilitating business execution:** You will act as the primary partner for our four business lines. Your focus is on clearing the path for them to execute their long\-term strategic AI plans, ensuring they have the support and resources needed to reach their goals quickly and effectively.
* **Defining the operational heartbeat:** You will establish the "cadence" of AI delivery—regular reviews, progress tracking, and feedback loops—that keep our business lines aligned and moving forward.
* **Providing a shared foundation:** You will lead the development of the "common ground"—the standards, tools, and shared platforms—that allow our business units to build AI solutions without having to solve the same infrastructure or governance problems in isolation.
* **Driving speed and quality:** You will help our business teams balance the need for rapid delivery with the need for high\-quality, reliable output. By implementing clear, lightweight ways of working, you will help teams avoid common pitfalls and keep projects on track.
* **Managing risk by design:** Instead of treating risk as a hurdle to be jumped at the end, you will help teams bake it into their processes from day one. You will ensure that Responsible AI and security practices are built into the workflow, protecting the business while maintaining momentum.
* **Ensuring strategic alignment:** You will oversee our portfolio to ensure that the work happening across the business lines stays tethered to ELEC’s overarching enterprise priorities. You will help teams focus their energy on the initiatives that provide the greatest return.
* **Supporting the transition:** We are working toward a future where our business lines are fully empowered to lead their own AI delivery. You will guide this evolution, scaling our efforts today to build a sustainable, business\-led model for 2030\.
* **Driving adoption and upskilling:** You will champion the human side of our transformation by leading efforts to upskill our workforce. In close coordination with ELEC HR, the GE Vernova Corporate Learning team, the ELEC CTO office, and Business Line AI teams, you will design and adapt training programs that directly address the unique missions and practical needs of our ELEC teams. By building targeted AI literacy and specialized expertise, you will ensure our people are empowered to adopt new tools and maximize the value of AI in their specific daily work.

**What you bring to the team**


* **A commitment to partnership:** You have a track record of supporting business units in achieving their strategic goals. You view your role as a service to the business lines, not as a central authority.
* **A "get it done" mindset:** You understand that the best strategy is only valuable if it can be executed. You are experienced in guiding complex initiatives through to delivery while maintaining high standards.
* **Balanced judgment:** You know how to provide enough guidance to ensure consistency across the company without creating unnecessary red tape that slows teams down.
* **Technical and business fluency:** You can communicate clearly with both technical delivery teams and business leadership, ensuring that everyone understands the goals and the path to achieving them.
* **Proven reliability:** You have a history of managing programs or operations where speed, quality, and risk management were all critical to success.

**How we’ll measure success**


* **LTS Execution:** Our business lines are successfully hitting the milestones set out in their long\-term AI strategy plans.
* **Operational Speed:** We have reduced the time it takes to get from an idea to a working, value\-driving solution.
* **Risk \& Quality:** Our AI initiatives consistently meet our internal standards for security and responsibility, with minimal friction.
* **Business Impact:** Every AI project we support can clearly demonstrate its contribution to ELEC’s business performance.

**Skills \& Academic Requirements**


To lead this transformation effectively, you will need a blend of technical understanding, operational discipline, and the ability to influence people.


* **Academic \& Professional Background:**
	+ **Degree:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
	+ **Experience:** Strong and proven leadership experience in operations, program management, or technical strategy, ideally within a large, global matrixed organization.
	+ **AI/Technical Fluency:** A solid grasp of the AI/ML landscape—not necessarily as a developer, but as a leader who understands the lifecycle of AI solutions, from data preparation to production and monitoring.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ **Strategic Change Management:** Proven success in leading large\-scale organizational shifts, including the ability to build and sustain engagement across diverse teams.
	+ **Operational Discipline:** Exceptional ability to build, manage, and refine the "cadence" of a business—tracking metrics, managing budgets, and maintaining project momentum.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated expertise in bridging the gap between technical teams (CTO/Engineering) and business stakeholders. You know how to translate technical requirements into business value and vice\-versa.
	+ **Learning \& Development Agility:** A strong track record of partnering with HR and Learning \& Development functions to design curriculum or enablement programs. You understand that "upskilling" is not just about classroom training, but about driving behavioral change.
	+ **Influencing \& Negotiation:** The ability to achieve alignment across different business lines without having direct line authority over every team member. You lead through persuasion, shared goals, and the value you provide.
	+ **Risk \& Governance Mindset:** A pragmatic approach to compliance and ethics. You can integrate guardrails into the development process so that they feel like an asset rather than an obstacle.

title: Director Of Revenue Operations
description:
**Director Of Revenue Operations \| Based in Barcelona**  

Kantox is a Barcelona\-based fintech acquired by BNP Paribas in 2022\. As Director of Revenue Operations, you will sit at the intersection of internal commercial execution and parent company alignment, reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer.


This is not a coordination role. You will own the RevOps function, lead the relationship with BNP Paribas commercial leadership, and drive the commercial initiatives that determine how Kantox scales.

**What you will work on**


Strategic Leadership

* Working hand in hand with the Chief Commercial Officer
* Building strategic reviews and recommendations for key meetings, including Strategic Reviews with BNP, Kantox Board meetings, and Quarterly Commercial meetings
* Ensuring all decisions made in the Commercial leadership team are executed seamlessly, in collaboration with Sales Team Managers
* Orchestrating the work of all teams represented in the commercial organisation: Business Development, Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, and Marketing


People Leadership

* Leading the Revenue Operations team (current organisation: 1 Sales Operations Specialist, 1 Implementation and Customer Specialist, 1 Marketing Specialist, 2 Quality Assurance Specialists, and 2 Salesforce Developers)
* Building and developing your Revenue Operations team: establishing clear career pathways, identifying skill gaps, and driving upskilling in areas like CRM, analytics, and process design
* Fostering career development and internal mobility: identifying high\-potential team members, creating stretch assignments and mentoring opportunities, and supporting movement across the commercial function
* Driving team engagement and culture: celebrating wins and ensuring your team understands how their work connects to commercial and organisational strategy


BNP Paribas Commercial Relations

* Representing the commercial organisation in recurrent BNPP stakeholder meetings: preparing agendas, presenting KPIs, deal status, and pipeline intelligence
* Coordinating efforts across local markets with Kantox and BNP local sales to ensure execution of the priorities defined in regular Kantox/BNPP meetings
* Managing BNP compliance and risk requests related to the commercial organisation including process improvement and executing internal audit recommendations


AI and Productivity

* Recommending new workflows for Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Revenue Operations leveraging AI
* Making the best of our tech stack using the AI capabilities of our providers
* Increasing sales closing ratio by enhancing the sales cycle with AI


Key Commercial Meetings

* Owning the organisation and content of key internal commercial meetings: sales kickoffs, quarterly commercial committee, and weekly Sales meetings
* Acting as a speaker at those events to give a clear vision of the commercial organisation's direction


Budget, Targets, and Compensation

* Participating in budget preparation with Finance and Senior Sales Management
* Designing commission plans with the CCO and following their proper execution
* Leveraging and administering SPIFF programs


Revenue Operations

* Being fully responsible for the reliability of all reporting for Senior Management, mainly Power BI and Salesforce dashboards, with the support of our Power BI specialists
* Overseeing the full RevOps tech stack including CRM, sales tools, and analytics, alongside team development and process optimisation
* Designing and driving revenue operations initiatives across sales process improvement, continuous training, forecasting accuracy, pricing strategies, and operational efficiency
* Ensuring the forecasting process is followed diligently across the commercial organisation, with clear accountability at every stage of the pipeline
* Driving continuous improvement across all key sales velocity metrics: pipeline size, average deal size, closing ratio, and sales cycle length
* Aligning Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation to ensure seamless handoffs, successful client onboarding, and consistent commercial execution
* Making data\-driven recommendations to evolve the sales cycle based on the evolution of the product, market, and competitive landscape

**The setup**


You will be based in our Barcelona office, working in a hybrid model and reporting directly to the CCO. You will lead a high\-performing Revenue Operations team and work closely with senior stakeholders both inside Kantox and within BNP Paribas. This is a role with real strategic weight and direct influence on how Kantox grows.

 **Who you are**


You have deep experience in revenue operations or commercial planning, and you know how to manage complex stakeholder relationships at C\-Level. You are equally comfortable presenting forecasts to senior leadership and getting into the detail of a CRM process improvement. You lead teams with clarity, build cross\-functional alignment, and operate effectively inside structured governance environments.


Concretely:

* 7\+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or commercial planning, preferably in SaaS
* Outstanding reliability: anything going through you will be properly executed by your team
* Proven experience managing strategic relationships with C\-Level stakeholders
* Strong financial acumen across budget planning, forecasting, revenue recognition, and KPI analysis
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable engaging senior executives and speaking in public forums
* Proven hands\-on experience with Salesforce
* Experience leading teams and driving cross\-functional initiatives in a scaling organisation
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail and comfort with complex governance structures
* Fluent in English

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in fintech, banking, or financial services
* Familiarity with large financial institutions such as banking groups or asset managers
* Background in FX, treasury, or trade finance operations

**What we offer**

* Competitive base salary and bonus
* Sponsored learning and development budget
* Free private health insurance
* Free language lessons (Spanish, English and French)
* Relocation package if required
* Flexible working hours and short Fridays
* Hybrid working model (4 office, 1 home)
* 36 days of annual leave
* Gym discounts and free sports activities
* Restaurant Ticket with monthly credit and regular cross\-team lunches
* Fresh fruit and unlimited coffee
* Pizza Fridays
* Barcelona office with 360° views of the city

**About Kantox**


We are a 200\-person fintech and a BNP Paribas company, with offices in London and Barcelona. We built a product that handles real financial complexity for clients who depend on it every day. As we deepen our integration with BNP Paribas and scale our commercial operations globally, this role sits at the centre of that ambition.


Kantox is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applicants regardless of background, nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, or disability status.

title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Benelux) - Orbit Program
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Amsterdam after. Customer base will be in the Benelux region, involving travel to meet clients in person.**

  

### **Role Description**



As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business\-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world's leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis' Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers' business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.


### **Launch Your Enterprise Software Career \- Orbit Graduate program**



Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12\-month Orbit Program.



During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.



This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.



Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands\-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:


* Discovery \& AI Solutioning
* Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
* Scoping business and technical requirements
* Effectively handling objections
* Developing industry domain knowledge
* Delivering impactful presentations and demos
* Understanding value selling and realization
* Managing customer accounts

### **What You'll Do:**


* **AI Discovery \& Solutioning:** Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product \& domain expert, find the best problem\-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* **Hackathons \& Prototyping:** Think out of the box, have a "can\-do" attitude and don't shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* **Agentic Process Transformation:** Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule\-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
* **Proof Projects:** End\-to\-end execution of business\-critical Proof\-of\-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.

* **Ensure Successful Project Outcome:** Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value \& adoption thresholds are reached
* **Best Practice Modeling:** Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.

### **What You Need:**


* Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
* Excellent academic performance
* Extensive internship experience or 1\-2 years of full\-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.

**Bonus Points:**

* Customer\-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
* Hands\-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
* Hands\-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. title: Head of Pricing and Monetization
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**


n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.


Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation

  

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.


We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data\-informed growth lever \- one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go\-to\-market, from our 1\.5 million\-strong community to global Enterprise accounts.


To do so, here's what you'll own:

**BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING**

* Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness\-to\-pay, gross margin, and customer value.
* Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast.
* Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings.

**DESIGN OUR PRICING \& PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE**

* Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self\-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add\-ons like our startup and charity plans.
* Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption\-based models as our product and cost\-to\-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect.
* Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features.

**DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS**

* Lead cross\-functional pricing decision\-making and secure buy\-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.
* Own the rollout of major pricing changes end\-to\-end, from decision to launch to measured impact.
* Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage\-based billing decisions.

**Requirements**

**Must\-have**

* **Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS**: You have 6\+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat\-based to usage\-based, or a platform repricing.
* **Hands\-on with modern pricing models**: You've personally designed and rolled out consumption\-based, outcome\-based, or AI\-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR.
* **Both self\-serve and Enterprise motions**: You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self\-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) *and* Enterprise, sales\-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough.
* **Deep analytical rigour**: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost\-to\-serve, gross margin, willingness\-to\-pay, and elasticity.
* **Billing fluency, technical and operational**: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true\-ups, and disputes.
* **Empathy for technical users and buyers**: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience.
* **Frameworks over bottlenecks**: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you.
* **Cross\-functional influence**: You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions.
* **Motivated by scope, not headcount**: You're energised by owning a global, high\-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* **Formal pricing training**: You've been trained at Simon\-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you.
* **Developer tools experience**: You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams.
* **Open source or freemium background**: You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust.

### **Why join us?**


At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap \- it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low\-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5\.2bn company monetises across community, self\-serve, and Enterprise, in 100\+ countries and across both cloud and self\-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote\-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.


Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?


Apply now \- and help us build the future of automation.

*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.*

***Our company language is English.***

*You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity\-inclusion\-and\-belonging\-n8n\-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).*

***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.*

**Benefits**
------------

* **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay.
* **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
* **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:


	+ **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
	+ **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
* **Health \& wellness** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US**: Multiple low\-premium, low\-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no\-cost premium HDHP option with a pre\-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
* **Future planning** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
* **Financial security** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
* **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
* **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
* **Remote\-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off\-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
* **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
* **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
* *Country\-specific details are provided in your contract.*

title: Senior Buyer - Electronic Components
location: Sant Boi de Llobregat, CT, ES
description:
#### **About Stark**


Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road\-legal VARG EX \& SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.


We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year\-on\-year), and building a team that will take us even further. If you want to work on a product that people are genuinely obsessed with, this is it.


Stark will become the global market leader in premium motorcycles. Building premium motorcycles requires innovation and we need your help to make us succeed


Our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry, by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.


This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

#### **The Role**


This isn't just a procurement role; it is a strategic position requiring a deep understanding of the global electronics ecosystem. You will be responsible for navigating the complexities of semiconductor cycles, managing relationships with top\-tier manufacturers, and identifying technical opportunities within our designs to optimize the supply chain.


You will report directly to the Purchasing Director and work as a bridge between Engineering and the global market to ensure our motorcycles remain at the cutting edge of electric performance.

#### **What You’ll Do**

* **Strategic Sourcing:** Navigate the global electronics manufacturing supplier landscape (EMS, Electronic Components Manufacturers \& Worldwide Electronics Distributors) to secure best\-in\-class partnerships.
* **Market Intelligence:** Act as the internal expert on semiconductor trends, memory market volatility, and global supply/demand shifts to proactively mitigate risk.
* **Technical Portfolio Discovery:** Review internal designs and technical portfolios to identify new manufacturers and alternative components (pin\-to\-pin or functional equivalents) that offer better lead times or cost\-efficiency.
* **Relationship Management:** Build and leverage high\-level relationships with major component manufacturers and global distributors
* **Commercial Ownership:** Manage RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs; negotiate Master Purchase Agreements that protect Stark’s agility in a volatile market.
* **Cost \& Inventory Control:** Drive aggressive cost\-reduction activities and "total cost of ownership" models without compromising the technical integrity of our assemblies.
* **Cross\-Functional Engineering Support:** Act as a technical consultant to the Engineering team during the design phase to ensure "design\-for\-availability."

#### **What you will bring to Stark**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of senior sourcing experience, specifically focused on **Electronic Components and** **assemblies.**
* **Education:** **Electronics Engineer** (highly valuable) or a technical degree with significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* **Global Landscape Expertise:** Deep knowledge of the global semiconductor players (Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, Analog Devices, Rohm, Infineon, Murata, etc.) and the wider distribution network.
* **Technical Discernment:** The ability to read a schematic or BOM and detect opportunities for supplier diversification or technical optimization.
* **Negotiation Prowess:** A skilled negotiator who understands the nuances of the electronics industry, from NRE costs to volume rebates and buffer stock agreements.
* **Mindset:** Results\-oriented, highly analytical, and passionate about sustainability.
* **Communication:** Fluent in English (must) and Spanish (highly desired).

#### **Why work with us?**

* The chance to work on a product people are genuinely passionate about
* A fast\-growing company with real momentum
* A creative, international team based in Barcelona
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Direct access to riders, race teams, and the product — this is not a remote\-from\-the\-product role
* Subsidized lunch in our in house restaurant
* Free access to our in\-house gym (including weekends!)
* 30 days of paid vacation

**At Stark, we don’t just accept difference—we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.**


We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurodiversity, or disability, feels a true sense of belonging. We believe that diverse teams make better decisions and that a culture of equity is a prerequisite for innovation.

**Accessibility:** If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process (such as assistive technology, extra time, or a specific format), please let us know at HR@starkfuture.com. We are here to support you.


We encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are excited to see how your unique perspective can help us grow

title: Head of Public Affairs
description:
**About your role**


As our Head of Public Affairs, you will be responsible for managing and shaping the public image of our brand and reputation. In this leadership position, you will spearhead the development and execution of strategies that enhance our reputation and foster positive relationships.


These include but are not limited to, relationships with:

* Civil servants and public authorities.
* Media outlets.
* Key internal stakeholders.


You will lead the public affairs team while working closely with other members of the Cooltra team.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute the organisation’s public affairs and government relations strategy in alignment with overall business objectives.
* Monitor political, regulatory, legislative, and policy developments at relevant local levels, national and international leves.
* Provide senior leadership with timely analysis, advice, and recommendations on public policy and political issues affecting the organisation.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government officials, policymakers, regulators, political stakeholders, industry associations, think tanks and other external partners.
* Lead advocacy strategies on priority policy and regulatory issues, including stakeholder mapping, coalition building, and direct engagement.
* Represent the organisation in meetings, consultations, industry forums, conferences, and other high\-level external settings.
* Develop policy positions, briefing papers, consultation responses, talking points, presentations, and executive briefings.
* Coordinate public affairs activity across business units and ensure consistent positioning and messaging.
* Work closely with Communications, Legal and Compliance and other relevant teams.
* Identify emerging political and regulatory risks and opportunities and develop appropriate response strategies.
* Manage relationships with external advisers, public affairs agencies, consultants, and industry associations where appropriate.
* Ensure all government and political engagement is conducted ethically, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws and internal policies.
* Identifying and developing new opportunities to participate in projects and tender processes, as well as managing and consolidating awarded projects, with the aim of ensuring their continuity and maximising the chances of renewal.
* The preparation of sustainability reports, a task that involves not only drafting the report, but also the collection, analysis, verification and presentation of information relating to environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.

**What You'll Need to Get the Job Done**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Political Science, or a related field.
* 8 years of work experience in public affairs, public relations, or related roles.
* Proven knowledge of local, national, and international government and legislative processes.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Proficiency in media monitoring tools.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to cultivate and sustain relationships across a broad spectrum of stakeholders.

**Why Cooltra**

* Multicultural and international organisation

At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.

  

Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?


If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!

 **Schneider Digital** is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.

  

Schneider Electric is a Fortune 500 global enterprise operating a product\-oriented infrastructure model structured around technical pillars (Network, Compute \& Storage, Cloud, Automation, Monitoring) and supported by a broad ecosystem of strategic vendors. This model enables specialization and execution at scale, but also creates fragmentation risks across prioritization, standards, financial control, vendor management, and service performance.

  

To address these risks, the Global Infrastructure Service Delivery (GISD) is establishing a Transversal Governance Team whose mission is to govern, assure, standardize, prioritize, and escalate — not to become a second operations organization or a reporting factory. Governance defines direction and control; pillars retain delivery ownership.


The ITSM \& Vendor Management Specialist is a hybrid, high\-impact role that bridges service performance (ITSM) discipline with strategic vendor oversight. The role ensures enterprise\-first outcomes, actionable transparency, and effective cross\-functional integration with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Enterprise Architecture, and the GTS PMO.

  

While this role combines responsibilities across both ITSM and Vendor Management, we are not seeking a deep subject matter expert in every area. We are looking for a professional with solid experience in one or both disciplines, strong learning agility, adaptability to change, and a willingness to grow alongside a newly established Governance Team.

This is a governance\-focused position rather than a hands\-on infrastructure operations role. The successful candidate will influence outcomes through collaboration, service governance, performance management, and stakeholder engagement across multiple technical pillars. **What will you do?**

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **A. ITSM / Service Performance, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**

* Own and publish the consolidated Infrastructure KPI / SLA Dashboard and monthly Infrastructure Availability \& Reliability Report (uptime, MTTR, MTBF, unplanned downtime), ensuring data quality, actionable insights, and timely reporting across all pillars. Maintain the Major Incident \& Post\-Mortem Register (P1/P2\), driving root\-cause analysis governance and preventive\-action follow\-through.
* Enforce observability and ITSM process standards (incident, problem, change, request, knowledge) across ServiceNow.
* Drive Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, tracking benefit realization and presenting outcomes to leadership.
* Govern aggregate service health; partner with pillar operations teams which remain accountable for instrumenting their domains.

**B. Vendor \& Contract Management**

* Act as the single point of governance for assigned strategic vendor relationships, fostering executive engagement while surfacing risks, issues, and opportunities to Infrastructure leadership.

* Support RFPs, sourcing events, contract negotiations, and renewal planning in partnership with Procurement and Legal, ensuring auditable sourcing decisions and preventing unfavorable auto\-renewals.

AstraZeneca Spain is a rising force in our global business. ### **Resilient trailblazers**


Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259586 **Date posted** 09/07/2026
“It is critical that we build and maintain our rich tradition of clinical expertise in support of developing life\-changing medicines for patients.” –Jose Baselga


The Baselga Cancer Research Scholars Program, initiated in 2020, is a 2\-year immersive education and research program for early\-career Oncologists who are inspired by science and by how clinical development has the potential to transform patient care. As part of a competitively selected cohort of Scholars, you will join an accelerated development track within Oncology R\&D. With individualized mentorship, there is opportunity to learn from a diverse group of experts across the drug development continuum, playing a pivotal role in channelling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients’ lives. Selected Scholars will join the current cohort of Baselga Cancer Research Scholars, building a vibrant community of drug developers. We are currently recruiting for the 2027 class with an aim to start the position in summer\-autumn 2027\.


**About AstraZeneca Oncology Research \& Development**


Our Oncology strategy is built with one goal in mind – pushing the boundaries of science to deliver life\-changing medicines to patients. We have a passion for discovery and a broad pipeline of next\-generation medicines, and together with a focus on execution excellence, we aim to expand treatment options and improve outcomes for patients with solid and haematological cancers. We’re pioneering innovative research across six scientific platforms: Tumor drivers and resistance; Immuno\-oncology, DNA damage response, Antibody drug conjugates, Epigenetics and Cell therapies.


Our ambition is to eliminate cancer as a cause of death. It’s our big vision that unites and inspires us. With multiple indications and high\-quality molecules at all stages of our innovative pipeline, we keep pushing forward. Focusing on cutting\-edge science with the latest technology to achieve breakthroughs. AZ is a place built on courage, curiosity and collaboration – we make bold decisions driven by patient outcomes.


**What you’ll do**


The 2027 AZ Baselga Cancer Research Scholars cohort will join AstraZeneca at a time of tremendous growth and acceleration in the oncology biologics portfolio. Working in a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment you will experience increasing levels of responsibility, following a structured learning plan in the following domains:


1\) **Clinical Study Assignment:** You will join a clinical study team and build experience as a medical leader in clinical development which could be in Early Clinical Development, Late Clinical Development, or one year in each. You will participate in weekly clinical and scientific meetings related to your clinical study, complete AstraZeneca training programs and participate in internal and external scientific meetings. You will work in a cross functional environment, contributing to and supporting Department/Clinical initiatives to improve the quality and content of all clinical programs as well as the cross functional/organization processes designed to effectively deliver our R\&D portfolio.


Specific duties and major responsibilities for the longitudinal medical project may include any of the following:


* Serving as medical director with primary responsibility for patient safety and conduct of assigned trials as well as overall data interpretation and safety surveillance
* Establishing and approving scientific methods for design and implementation of applicable clinical protocols, data collection systems, and final reports
* Assisting in design of clinical development plans and overall strategy for compounds, therapeutic classes of compounds or indications in light of developments in the area of clinical and pharmaceutical oncology
* Collaborating with pre\-clinical and translational sciences, and senior management in assessing requirements for emerging products
* Participating in the selection and management activities of CROs
* Supervising project team members in planning, conducting and evaluating clinical trials
* Planning and managing investigator meetings, advisory boards and other scientific committees

2\) **Rotational program:** During the course of your program, you will be involved in 3\-6 month long rotations across various groups to gain a better understanding of the cross\-functional departments. This could include:


* Patient safety
* Clinical operations
* Regulatory affairs
* Biostatistics
* Medical affairs
* Translational medicine or precision medicine

3\) **Longitudinal Research Project:** You will have opportunity to lead an innovative research project of your choosing for the duration of the 2\-year program, which may be an area of special interest to you and AstraZeneca, or alternatively focus on one or more of the rotational functions. You will be able to harness rich internal datasets and expertise, aiming to deliver a research project at the end of the Program which will be presented to key internal stakeholders, at a key scientific meeting and published in a peer\-reviewed journal.


**Essential for the role:**


MD or equivalent required; ideally board certified (or eligible) preferred in Oncology or Haematology/Oncology
