title: Customer Complaints Senior Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK\-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

**About the Opportunity**
The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for the overall compliance culture at the company. We're a team of risk\-minded problem solvers who advise the business on the company's regulatory obligations and enterprise risk.
In this role, you will own OKX's Global Customer Complaints Program and report directly to the Compliance Chief of Staff. You will work closely with Local Compliance, Legal, Customer Support, Product, Operations, and Risk teams to promote consistent complaint handling across jurisdictions, maintain alignment with regulatory requirements, and provide effective second\-line oversight and challenge.
A key part of the role will be turning customer complaints into actionable compliance and conduct\-risk intelligence. You will oversee complaints governance and quality assurance, identify trends and potential systemic issues, support root\-cause analysis and remediation, and provide senior leadership with clear reporting on customer outcomes and emerging risks.
You will also support the development, coordination, and tracking of responses to regulators, working directly with Legal and Local Compliance teams on regulatory inquiries, escalated complaints, and related supervisory matters. This requires strong regulatory judgment, excellent written communication, and the ability to coordinate complex matters across multiple teams and jurisdictions.

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop, coordinate, and track responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and escalated complaints, partnering with Legal and Local Compliance teams to gather and validate facts, prepare clear and defensible responses, manage review and approval processes, meet regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments, remediation, and follow\-up through closure.
* Maintain global regulatory alignment by partnering with local Heads of Compliance to identify changes in jurisdictional requirements and ensure global policies, standards, procedures, and local requirements remain current and appropriately implemented.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end complaints control framework, including complaint identification and classification, regulatory and internal service\-level requirements, escalation thresholds, documentation standards, investigation and resolution expectations, and closed\-loop validation.
* Own the second\-line oversight and quality assurance, including risk\-based testing of complaint handling, identification of control gaps and customer\-outcome issues, tracking of remediation, and escalation of issues.
* Turn complaint data into actionable compliance and conduct\-risk intelligence by monitoring trends, recurring issues, root causes, regulatory complaints, overdue cases, customer outcomes, and potential systemic issues requiring broader investigation or remediation.
* Own complaints governance and executive reporting, including reporting to compliance committees and serving as the standing owner of the complaints agenda for compliance leadership meetings.
* Maintain the complaint management database, service level agreement adherence, and escalation thresholds across all regions.
* Serve as the central Compliance point of contact for material complaint matters, including complaints or inquiries escalated to regulators, ensuring consistent governance, appropriate escalation, and defensible documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement of the framework, using QA results, regulatory developments, complaint trends, and lessons learned to strengthen controls and improve customer outcomes globally.

**What We Look For In You**
* Strong experience developing and managing responses to regulators is required, including regulatory inquiries, information requests, examinations, escalated customer complaints, and other supervisory matters. Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross\-functional inputs, develop clear and defensible written responses, manage regulatory deadlines, and track resulting commitments and remediation through closure.
* Significant experience in regulatory compliance, conduct risk, consumer protection, complaints oversight, or a related discipline, ideally within a highly regulated and globally distributed organization.
* Demonstrated experience owning or overseeing a multi\-jurisdictional compliance framework, including translating regulatory requirements into scalable global standards, controls, monitoring, and governance while appropriately incorporating local requirements.
* Strong regulatory and customer\-outcome judgment, with the ability to distinguish individual service issues from matters presenting potential regulatory, conduct, consumer\-harm, reputational, or systemic risk.
* Demonstrated experience with root\-cause analysis and systemic remediation, including assessing whether broader customer populations may be affected and driving appropriate corrective action.
* Strong second\-line oversight and challenge capabilities, with experience designing or operating risk\-based monitoring, QA, issue escalation, remediation tracking, and governance processes.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities, trend analysis, SLA monitoring, management information, and executive reporting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with regulators, Legal, Compliance, senior executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Proven ability to influence geographically dispersed teams and senior stakeholders.

**Nice\-To\-Haves**
* Experience designing or overseeing a global customer complaints program across multiple regulatory regimes, particularly the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, APAC, LATAM, and/or Middle East.
* Familiarity with complaints\-handling and customer protection expectations across major global regulatory regimes, including those established by the FCA, CFPB, MAS, European Supervisory Authorities (EBA, ESMA and EIOPA), and other relevant national competent authorities and dispute\-resolution bodies.
* Relevant professional certification or advanced qualification such as CAMS, CFE, CRCM, CCEP/CCEP\-I, ICA compliance qualifications, CIA, CRCMP, JD or equivalent legal qualification, or a comparable compliance, risk, or audit credential.

title: Ads Specialist
description:
**Hola Crack!**
---------------


Buscamos a nuestro próximo Social Ads Specialist para Atlas— alguien que no separa datos de creatividad, porque sabe que van de la mano. Ojo analítico para detectar qué está funcionando, instinto para convertirlo en la próxima pieza, y las ganas de que cada campaña sea mejor que la anterior.


Si un número te dice tanto como una buena idea, y eres de los resolutivos que no esperan a que se lo pidan… bienvenido/a a la manada.

**¿Quienes somos?**
-------------------


Todo el mundo cuenta la historia bonita de startup. La nuestra no es esa.


Somos Ucademy: empezamos en 2022, cuando Ramiro y Pablo volvieron de Bali con una idea y ni un euro de inversión externa. Vino un año de crecer demasiado rápido, otro de puro aguante — y en 2025 arrancó un crecimiento real, del 200% interanual. Hoy, en 2026, con cinco años cumplidos y la casa en orden, somos una manada que va a muerte de verdad.


Dentro de esa manada está Atlas, nuestra academia online de Selectividad, PCE y Acceso \+25, con un 97% de alumnos en su primera opción de carrera. Y detrás de esa cifra hay campañas que funcionan todos los días — buscamos a alguien que no separe datos de creatividad: capaz de convertir métricas en decisiones y necesidades de campaña en piezas creativas.

**‍‍ ¿Con quién trabajarás?**
-----------------------------

* **Irene Seguer** (Head of Marketing)
* **Carlota Fernández** (Brand Specialist)
* **Michelangelo Iossa** (Social Ads Specialist)
* **Marta Varela** (Marketing Specialist)

**Tu misión**
-------------


Serás el puente entre el reporting diario, la optimización táctica de campañas, y la producción creativa junto a Brand. Vigilarás de cerca cómo van las campañas, detectarás desviaciones antes de que sean un problema, ajustarás lo que haga falta ajustar, y ayudarás a que las nuevas creatividades salgan a tiempo.


Aquí vas a aprender haciendo, no observando.

**Qué harás**
-------------

**Reporting** — Ser los ojos de la manada en el día a día de las campañas.  

Revisarás a diario las métricas de las campañas activas en Meta, TikTok y Google (spend, CPL, CAC, CTR). Actualizarás dashboards y reportes de seguimiento. Detectarás pronto cualquier desviación y la escalarás al responsable de Paid.

**️ Optimización de campañas** — Pasar de "veo un problema" a "lo soluciono".  

Harás ajustes tácticos sobre campañas en curso: pausar o escalar anuncios según rendimiento, rotar creatividades fatigadas, revisar segmentaciones y pujas. Aplicarás lo aprendido en el reporting diario para mantener el CAC dentro de objetivo.

**Colaboración con Brand**  

Participarás activamente en el sprint semanal de creatividades: trasladarás a Brand qué formatos o ángulos necesita Paid según lo que está funcionando. Apoyarás en el diseño de piezas (estáticas y vídeo) y en la redacción de guiones y copies. Ayudarás a preparar los creativos para su lanzamiento en cada plataforma.

**Cómo se verá el éxito**
-------------------------

**30 días — tus primeros pasos en la jungla**

* Te integras en la operativa diaria de Paid.
* Reportas de manera autónoma sobre las campañas.
* Entregas y activas tu primera pieza creativa en campaña.


Objetivo: demostrar que dominas las métricas clave, conoces las plataformas y aportas valor desde ya, aunque con supervisión.

**60 días — moverte solo por el terreno**

* Gestionas el reporting y la optimización táctica sin depender de otros.
* Eres proactivo/a en el sprint de creatividades.
* Solo necesitas supervisión en decisiones de mayor impacto.


Objetivo: que dejes de necesitar que te digan qué hacer cada día.

**90 días — parte de la manada**

* Te conviertes en un miembro consolidado del equipo.
* Tomas decisiones de optimización de campañas sin supervisión directa.


Objetivo: ser una pieza fiable del sistema de Paid.

**Qué buscamos en ti**
----------------------

* Experiencia, aunque sea inicial o de prácticas, gestionando o dando soporte en campañas de Ads (Meta, TikTok y/o Google).
* Nociones de diseño gráfico y manejo de al menos una herramienta (Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator o Figma).
* Capacidad de lectura e interpretación de métricas de campañas (CTR, CPL, CAC, CPM).
* Capacidad de redacción de guiones o copies publicitarios.

**El animal que buscamos**
--------------------------


Te imaginamos:

* **Auténtico/a de verdad**, resolutivo/a y proactivo/a — de los que actúan antes de que se lo pidan.
* **Con ganas de trabajar en manada**, porque sabes que solo se llega lejos si se llega junto al equipo.
* **Con capacidad analítica**: los números no te asustan, te hablan.
* **Con hambre creativa real**, más allá de solo ejecutar lo que otros piensan.
* **Organizado/a y con atención al detalle**, incluso cuando todo se mueve rápido.
* **Ágil bajo presión**, sin perder criterio ni cabeza fría.
* **Perfil junior**, con buena actitud y hambre de jungla.


Si te reconoces en esta lista… bienvenido/a a la manada.

**¿QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS?**
----------------------

* ️ **Visibilidad real de todo el negocio** y del impacto directo de tus contrataciones.
* **Aprendizaje brutalmente acelerado** junto a un Senior que te enseñará todo el *know\-how*.
* **4 semanas de teletrabajo en verano y 2 semanas en Navidad**.
* **Horario:** L a V de 10:30h a 19:30h (¡y miércoles de teletrabajo!).
* **Rango salarial:** 20k brutos anuales
* ️ **25 días de vacaciones**
* **\+ 3 adicionales (tu cumple, 24 de diciembre y 31 de diciembre)**
* **\+ 3 días extra:**


	+ Tu cumpleaños
	+ 24 de diciembre
	+ 31 de diciembre
* **Seguro médico privado \& Payflow**.
* **Wellhub (Gympass)**.
* **Oficinas top en Madrid (Cuzco)**.
* **Empresa rentable, con cultura brutal y en constante crecimiento**.


Si realmente cumples los requisitos, tienes el hambre y estás 100% capacitado/a para dar el salto, **queremos conocerte ya**.

description:
**ABOUT US**



In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best\-in\-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry\-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4\.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.


**LIFE AT TKWW**



At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life’s most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well\-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.


### **ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:**



TKWW is looking for a **Senior Data Scientist** to join our team of data professionals supporting our Marketplace. The Senior Data Scientist will play a critical role in shaping data strategy, guiding experimentation, and driving impact through advanced analytics. They will partner with cross\-functional teams—including product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders—to design experiments, develop analytical tools, and ensure we are making data\-driven decisions that deliver measurable results. As a trusted advisor and mentor, this person will both lead analyses directly and elevate the work of the broader team.


### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Gather, analyze, and interpret data to deliver business impact and help the organization make informed decisions
* Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, causal inference) to uncover insights and guide strategy
* Forecast and simulate hypotheticals to provide early potential signals before large initiatives start
* Design and analyze A/B and multivariate testing experiments; guide experimentation best practices across teams
* Design, build, and maintain reusable, scalable data products and self\-serve capabilities used by multiple internal teams
* Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations, linking insights to business outcomes such as ROI, conversion, retention, and revenue
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product, relevant data assets, and the outcomes of past experiments and analyses
* Identify opportunities for new data products and integrations, prioritize a backlog of data assets and use cases, and collaborate with business partners to implement them
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure strong internal customer focus and alignment
* Partner with engineers to ensure appropriate and scalable tracking is in place

* Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences
* Strong business acumen and ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and decision frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment through data\-driven insights and recommendations
* Advanced knowledge of statistics, including hypothesis testing, regression, causal inference, and forecasting
* Hands\-on experience with experiment design, analysis, and rollout of A/B and multivariate tests
* Advanced SQL skills and ability to write efficient, production\-ready queries
* Strong Python skills for data manipulation, visualization, and advanced analysis
* Knowledge of data modeling and experience partnering with engineers on data infrastructure
* Experience prioritizing and managing analytical work, data assets, or product backlogs in a cross\-functional environment

This isn't about replacing our people's expertise — it's about equipping every employee to use AI to raise the bar on the work we do together.

### **Diverse collaborators**


This is a speak\-up culture that values collaboration. You’ll proactively bring your unique perspectives, experiences and skills to the table and seek the same from others. With our international team composition and the need for fast\-paced collaboration, you’ll always be building new connections with colleagues.


### **Cutting\-edge innovators**


When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Every day, you’ll help make history, empowered to ignite your creativity and build something enduring.


### **Resilient trailblazers**


Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-258650 **Date posted** 09/04/2026
**Role Overview**


A senior engineering leadership role responsible for the technical direction, hands\-on delivery, and production scaling of AI solutions across enterprise enabling functions — including **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, Compliance, and Business Development**.


This is a **builder\-leader role**. The Engineering Director combines deep hands\-on AI engineering — designing and shipping multi\-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and governed AI applications — with the technical leadership required to drive a team from opportunity identification through to production deployment. They bring a rare and deliberate combination: the ability to move from idea to working proof\-of\-concept in days, alongside significant depth in **AI governance**, **operational resilience**, and **regulatory compliance** — not as adjacent knowledge, but as a core professional discipline that shapes how they build, assess, and operate AI systems.


The role sits within the Enterprise AI function and works in close partnership with enterprise technology, data engineering, technology governance, legal, information security, and functional stakeholders to deliver AI that is **production\-grade, auditable, and compliant from the first commit** — not retrofitted at the end. Given geographic considerations, the role carries particular responsibility for navigating multi\-jurisdictional data sovereignty, regulatory divergence, and cross\-border AI governance — ensuring systems are defensible under all applicable regulatory regimes.


**Context**


Enabling functions — HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance — govern how an organisation hires, contracts, spends, reports, partners, audits, and maintains compliance. They represent **high\-value AI opportunities** and **high\-consequence environments** — where outputs carry regulatory, financial, and reputational weight. Realising value at scale requires engineering leadership that can navigate complex data landscapes, build for reuse, and embed governance, human oversight, and operational resilience into architecture decisions from the outset.


These AI applications do not exist in a vacuum. Each system must be governed — classified, registered, monitored, auditable, and defensible to regulators, auditors, and internal oversight functions. The governance and resilience challenge is twofold: building AI systems that are *themselves* resilient and well\-governed, and ensuring the frameworks, processes, and controls that surround those systems are robust, proportionate, and continuously maintained. The role demands someone who has operated at this intersection for a significant portion of their career — not someone encountering governance as a new discipline.


This role is designed for an engineer who has already built AI applications inside a **large, regulated enterprise**, who has **demonstrated experience delivering AI solutions across multiple enabling functions** (e.g., HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit), who has significant experience governing AI systems and embedding operational resilience disciplines around them, and who treats regulatory requirements as **architecture decisions** — not compliance checkboxes.


**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Technical Direction \& Architecture**


* Lead the engineering roadmap for AI across enabling functions, aligning architecture, delivery sequencing, and capability development to business priorities across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance**
* Set architectural direction for scalable, governed AI platforms — designing for **modularity**, **cross\-functional reuse**, and **compliance from the outset**
* Make high\-consequence technical decisions on architecture, build\-vs\-buy, model strategy (foundation models, fine\-tuning, multi\-provider orchestration, RAG), and integration patterns
* Drive **platform thinking over project thinking** — building shared components, reusable agent patterns, and common governance instrumentation that accelerate delivery across the portfolio
* Ensure architecture accounts for data sovereignty requirements — model routing, data residency, and hosting decisions that respect jurisdictional boundaries and cross\-border transfer requirements
* Shape investment cases for senior stakeholders, articulating engineering decisions in terms of scalability, risk, regulatory defensibility, and value creation

**2\. Hands\-On AI Engineering \& Delivery**


* Design and ship **multi\-agent LLM architectures** across multiple model providers, choosing models against product requirements and compliance constraints — including sovereignty\-aware routing through region\-specific infrastructure where required
* Build **RAG pipelines** over real enterprise corpora with named single\-purpose agents, hallucination guards before any user\-facing output, and immutable audit logging at every stage
* Use AI\-assisted development tooling to compress delivery from months to days, while keeping architecture decisions, model routing, and guardrails under deliberate human control
* Lead technical design for complex solutions spanning enabling functions — **HR policy automation, contract risk scoring, procurement analytics, compliance monitoring, financial forecasting, audit analytics, and document intelligence** — with governance built in from the first build
* Ensure rapid experimentation capability with clear engineering gates between proof\-of\-concept, pilot, and production — measuring against real data and real success criteria, not mock demos

**3\. AI Governance \& Regulatory Compliance**


*This is a defining pillar of the role.* The organisation requires an engineering leader with significant, demonstrated experience in AI governance — someone who has designed governance frameworks, built governance tooling, and operated in governance roles — not simply complied with governance requirements set by others.


* **Governance architecture**: Design and operate the governance structures that surround AI applications — classification and tiering, risk assessment, model registration, approval workflows, ongoing monitoring obligations, and decommissioning criteria
* **Regulatory compliance (multi\-jurisdictional)**: Ensure systems meet requirements under applicable data protection laws, AI\-specific regulations (e.g., EU AI Act risk classification, emerging national AI frameworks), and sector\-specific operational resilience expectations — navigating divergence and maintaining defensibility under multiple regimes
* **Data sovereignty**: Design data\-residency and model\-routing approaches that respect adequacy arrangements, data\-transfer mechanisms, and sovereignty constraints — ensuring processing is appropriately separated by jurisdiction where required, with sovereign model options (e.g., region\-specific cloud deployments, local model hosting)
* **Responsible agentic architecture**: Design systems where AI agents reason autonomously but consequential action is human\-gated — with every decision writing an audit row recording what model decided what, on what evidence
* **Governance\-by\-design**: Embed deterministic classification/routing layers, human\-in\-the\-loop oversight, model/data cards, and full audit trails into standard engineering practice — treating these as first\-class architecture components, not afterthoughts
* **Second\-line posture**: Ensure governance tooling supports independent review — maintaining separation between the teams that build and the functions that assess, with tool design reflecting this control
* **Domain\-specific requirements**: Ensure AI systems handling financially material data (Finance), legally privileged documents (Legal), employee\-sensitive information (HR), supplier\-confidential data (Procurement), or audit evidence (Audit) meet the specific governance and evidential standards those domains require (e.g., SOX, legal privilege, chain\-of\-custody, employment law)
* **Lifecycle governance**: Own the ongoing governance obligations for live AI systems — periodic re\-assessment, performance review against stated tolerances, change\-impact assessment, and documented decision trails for model updates or retirement

**4\. Operational Resilience — For AI Systems**


*The second defining pillar.* The role requires significant experience in operational resilience as a discipline — not just awareness, but hands\-on engineering delivery.


* Engineer operational resilience into AI applications — circuit breakers, provider fallbacks, graceful degradation, fail\-safe defaults, and dependency\-aware architecture so essential functions survive outages
* **Design for failure**: assume model providers, data sources, and integration points will fail, and ensure user\-facing services degrade safely rather than catastrophically
* Ensure AI systems are mapped against the organisation's important business services framework — with defined impact tolerances, recovery objectives, and tested failover paths

**5\. Engineering Leadership \& Team Development**


* Lead a multi\-disciplinary engineering team comprising software, ML, data, and platform engineers — recruiting, developing, and retaining strong technical talent
* Set engineering culture and standards for **code quality**, **testing**, **documentation**, **peer review**, and **production readiness**
* Develop senior technical contributors and engineering leads — building depth and succession within the team
* Mentor and enable non\-technical colleagues across enabling functions to ship their own AI applications, building AI literacy across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance**
* Manage capacity and team topology — making deliberate choices about structure, specialisation, and balance across discovery, delivery, and sustainment

**6\. Delivery \& Production Excellence**


* Drive end\-to\-end engineering delivery from architecture through to production deployment, scaling, monitoring, and lifecycle management
* Partner with enterprise technology teams to leverage shared platforms, infrastructure, and services — ensuring solutions are built on common foundations and contribute back to enterprise capability
* Establish and enforce standards for model serving, data pipelines, API design, integration patterns, security, and observability
* Drive **MLOps maturity** including CI/CD, automated testing, performance monitoring, incident management, and capacity planning
* Own the data engineering approach for AI across enabling functions — pipelines, feature stores, and data products designed for quality, governance, and reuse
* Establish data quality, lineage, and governance standards appropriate for financially material data, legally privileged documents, employee PII, and personally identifiable information subject to applicable data protection laws

**7\. Model Quality, Drift \& Assurance**


* Establish **model\-drift and bias monitoring** across the portfolio — measuring divergence across runs and generating targeted refinement recommendations
* Design and operate AI red\-team capability to probe and refine model outputs before release and on an ongoing basis
* Build automated fairness testing, explainability pipelines, and decision audit trails embedded in standard workflows
* Own technical risk management across the portfolio including model degradation, data quality drift, dependency risk, and integration risk
* Ensure model assurance reporting meets the expectations of internal audit, technology governance, and external regulators

**8\. Scaling Through Partnership**


* Work in close partnership with enterprise technology to align on shared infrastructure, platform services, tooling, and engineering standards
* Identify and scale opportunities across enabling functions — recognising where a solution proven in one function (e.g., contract intelligence in Legal) can be adapted and deployed in another (e.g., supplier risk in Procurement)
* Engage external technology partners strategically — co\-developing or integrating capabilities where they accelerate delivery or provide specialist functionality
* Shape joint programmes with partners, defining technical scope, integration architecture, and quality standards — ensuring partnerships deliver production\-grade outcomes
* Build a **scaling model** that leverages shared services, external partners, and cross\-functional reuse to multiply impact without proportional headcount growth

**9\. Stakeholder Partnership \& Adoption**


* Serve as a credible technical partner to functional leaders across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance** — providing counsel on AI opportunity, risk, regulatory posture, and investment
* Work as an **internal consultant**: run discovery with each business unit, surface real problems, frame concrete use cases with measurable success criteria, and drive adoption through continuous UX iteration and direct user\-feedback loops
* Translate between engineering complexity and business strategy — communicating trade\-offs, timelines, and constraints so leaders can make informed decisions
* Measure success by **real adoption and operational impact**, not by demonstrations — building KPI/KRI frameworks giving leaders visibility into usage, quality, and value

**10\. Enterprise AI Integration**


* Represent enabling functions within enterprise AI leadership forums and architecture governance, ensuring alignment on standards, platform strategy, and shared services
* Contribute to enterprise AI governance including architecture review boards, AI policy development, and standards evolution
* Drive reuse and knowledge sharing — identifying where governance and resilience patterns developed for enabling functions can accelerate delivery elsewhere
* Advocate for enabling function requirements within the broader enterprise technology agenda, ensuring platform priorities reflect the needs of regulated, process\-critical functions

title: Account Executive

title: Senior Direct Response Funnel Copywriter & Strategist
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are looking for an exceptional senior direct response copywriter to take ownership of our post\-click funnels. This is not a role for someone who receives a brief, writes the copy and moves on. We are looking for someone who treats funnels the way an exceptional creative strategist treats advertising: research the customer and the market, form a hypothesis, develop the concept, write the copy, get the funnel launched, study the performance, identify the constraint, develop the next test, and turn every result into a feedback loop.


You will be deeply involved in the commercial performance of everything you write. Once a funnel goes live you should be watching click\-through rates, advertorial to sales page click\-through, quiz completion, sales page and checkout conversion, revenue per visitor, average order value, order bump and upsell take rates, refund rates and contribution margin. A page is not finished when the copy is approved. It is finished when it has launched, been measured, and produced a learning that improves the next page.


Your ultimate objective is to remove the founders from writing and reviewing routine funnel copy. Initially they will remain closely involved and may still write a large share of it. You will work directly with them, learn their frameworks, understand their decision\-making, and gradually take ownership of the function. Success means reaching the point where the founders no longer need to write funnel copy, rewrite your work, or independently double\-check it before launch. From there you create leverage through AI systems, documented processes and, in time, additional writers trained and managed beneath you.


A Note on the Category


This is claims\-led direct response, not product\-led ecommerce, and the distinction matters more than any other line in this description. Our products address chronic pain and mobility. The benefit is not visually obvious, it cannot be demonstrated in a photograph, and it cannot be sold on aspiration. Belief has to be built through mechanism, proof, advertorial and presell structure, and honest handling of objections, all inside the compliance limits of a health category.


Copywriters who have scaled fashion, accessories, beauty or other visually self\-evident products often find that their playbook does not transfer. A strong track record in a product\-led category is welcome but does not substitute for this. We will prioritize candidates who have written for health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category and who understand what can and cannot be said.


Why This Role Is Different


The founders have generated more than nine figures in post\-purchase upsell revenue in under twenty\-four months. That figure is post\-purchase upsell revenue specifically, not total front\-end company revenue. You will get direct access to the frameworks behind those results, existing research, templates, processes and funnel data, direct feedback and training from the founders, a portfolio of brands and offers with significant traffic, a high\-volume testing environment where your ideas get launched and measured, and real commercial data across multiple funnel types, offers and traffic sources.


This is an opportunity to develop beyond being a copywriter. The right person can progress toward Head of Funnel Copy, Head of Funnel Strategy, Director of Conversion, or operator of one of our portfolio brands. We prefer to promote from within, and progression is based on commercial results, leadership ability and the amount of responsibility you can absorb.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


Post\-Click Funnel Strategy


Act as the strategic owner of post\-click messaging and conversion copy. Participate in marketing, campaign and offer planning, understand what each traffic source needs after the click, and ensure message continuity between the advertisement, presell page, sales page, checkout and upsell journey. Recommend the right funnel format based on the offer, traffic source, customer awareness and market sophistication, and determine when a campaign needs an advertorial, listicle, quiz, long\-form page, short\-form page or another structure. Collaborate with media buyers and creative strategists to understand the promise that generated the click, and identify disconnects between the ad message and the landing page experience. Your remit begins at the click, but you must understand the whole acquisition system to make intelligent post\-click decisions.


Customer and Market Research


Research the customer before developing the copy. Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, customer interviews, call transcripts, refund reasons and community discussions. Study competitor offers, positioning, mechanisms, pricing and funnel structures. Identify desires, fears, frustrations, failed solutions, objections and buying triggers, understand the customer's level of awareness and the sophistication of the market, and distinguish between what customers say they want and what their behaviour suggests they value. Build voice\-of\-customer libraries that preserve the language customers actually use, validate that claims are supportable and appropriate for the category, and convert raw research into usable copy insight rather than research documents nobody reads.


Hypothesis Before Writing


Every meaningful funnel project begins with a clear hypothesis. Identify the metric or funnel stage being targeted, diagnose the likely reason for underperformance, state the customer insight behind the diagnosis, define what will change and why it should influence behaviour, select a primary success metric and the guardrails around it, and determine what result would validate or invalidate the idea. The first question is not what copy should I write. It is what is the constraint, why does it exist, and what evidence suggests this is the right solution.


Writing Complete Funnels


Write and optimize new offer positioning, unique mechanisms, big ideas, hooks and leads, advertorials, listicles, quiz flows, long\-form and short\-form sales pages, product detail pages, offer sections, pricing and bundle presentation, guarantees, checkout copy, order bumps, post\-purchase upsells, downsells, cross\-sells, funnel transitions, calls to action, and the supporting briefs for page graphics and visual proof. You must be able to develop a major long\-form funnel from a blank page and equally to identify and rewrite the one critical section inside an existing funnel.


The Offer, Not Only the Words


Copy cannot be separated from the offer. You will think critically about positioning, price, quantity, bundles, discounts, bonuses, guarantees, payment options, shipping thresholds, subscription structures, order bumps, upsell sequencing and offer continuity through the funnel. You should be willing to conclude that the copy is not the main problem and that the right recommendation is to change the offer, reorder the upsells, change the price, improve the guarantee, remove a step or target a different segment. Your responsibility is to improve the commercial result, not to defend the original brief.


Funnel Economics


Understand the underlying economics of each offer, including selling price, cost of goods, pick and pack, shipping, payment processing, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, subscription take rates, upsell margins, gross and contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, and revenue and profit per visitor. A higher AOV is not automatically better if contribution margin falls, a higher conversion rate is not better if refunds rise, and a pricing test must be judged on full funnel economics rather than one isolated metric. You do not need to be a finance professional. You do need to think like an owner.


Staying Close to Live Performance


Once your copy is launched, confirm the correct version went live, review performance against the control and at each funnel step, segment where appropriate, compare mobile and desktop, look for discrepancies between traffic sources, use heatmaps and behavioural data where helpful, and compare primary against guardrail metrics. Document what worked, what did not and why, recommend the next action, and feed every meaningful learning back into research and writing. You should feel personal ownership of the result without becoming defensive when an idea loses. A losing test that produces a real learning is useful. A test launched without a hypothesis and never reviewed is not.


The Learning System and AI Leverage


Build and maintain a searchable archive of tests and results recording the original problem, hypothesis, change, result and learning. Identify recurring patterns across brands and funnel types, separate genuine principles from conclusions drawn on insufficient data, convert repeated winners into reusable frameworks, and prevent failed concepts from being unknowingly repeated. Insight should become company knowledge rather than living in one person's head.


Alongside that, become highly AI\-enabled. Use and improve AI\-assisted systems for research synthesis, voice\-of\-customer clustering, transcript and review analysis, competitor and mechanism research, angle development, hypothesis generation, copy outlining, first drafts, variations, objection identification, quality control, claim consistency review, funnel analysis and test documentation. You will not use a generic chatbot to produce first drafts. You will help build structured processes containing the right context, approved source material, brand knowledge, customer research, historical winners, founder frameworks, defined quality criteria and clear review stages. The standard is not whether AI was used. It is whether AI helped us produce better research, better copy, more tests and faster learning without lowering quality.


What We Are Looking For


Substantial professional experience in direct response copywriting, gained over several years writing for real offers with meaningful traffic. A portfolio containing both long\-form and short\-form funnel copy, significant experience writing for cold traffic, and proven experience in DTC ecommerce, direct response or another measurable\-response environment. Evidence that your work has generated meaningful revenue or measurable conversion improvement. Experience writing complete funnels rather than isolated page sections, including advertorials, listicles, sales pages, quizzes, checkouts and post\-purchase upsells.


Experience in health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category, and an understanding of how to build belief where the benefit is not visually demonstrable. A strong grasp of customer awareness, market sophistication, offers, mechanisms, leads, proof, objections and risk reversal. The ability to conduct and synthesize deep customer research and turn it into a clear hypothesis and a persuasive argument.


Strong analytical fluency and comfort with funnel performance data, the ability to diagnose where a funnel is losing customers, a working understanding of AOV, revenue per visitor, upsell take rates, gross margin and contribution margin, experience creating and evaluating conversion tests, and the ability to distinguish correlation, noise and meaningful evidence.


Strong AI fluency with evidence of using AI inside a real research, writing or analysis workflow. The ability to write quickly without sacrificing strategic depth, the confidence to challenge a weak brief or assumption, the humility to change direction when the data disproves an idea, the communication skills to work with founders, media buyers, designers and analysts, and the potential to train and lead additional writers as the function grows. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


High\-volume Meta, native, Google or affiliate traffic, post\-purchase upsell funnels, portfolio or multi\-brand environments, CRO or direct response agencies, subscription offers, and experience building copy systems or training programs are all highly advantageous.


Evidence We Expect to See


Applicants should demonstrate results, not simply submit polished writing samples. Strong evidence includes funnel revenue, conversion rate improvements, revenue per visitor and AOV improvements, upsell take rate and contribution margin improvements, results against an established control, evidence of scaling an offer, before and after funnel performance, and a sequence of tests showing how an insight developed over time.


We understand that candidates may be under confidentiality agreements. Results can be anonymized, but you should still be able to explain what the offer was, what the original problem was, what you personally owned, what research you conducted, what hypothesis you formed, what you changed, which metric moved, how much traffic supported the conclusion, and what happened next. We are more interested in clear thinking and honest attribution than impressive numbers without context.


This Role Is Not


This is not a junior copywriting position, a brand copy role, a content or social media role, or an ad\-copy\-only position. It is not a role where you write from a brief without questioning it, where your responsibility ends when the document is submitted, or where you would rather your work was not measured. It is not a pure CRO analyst role in which you never write, nor a management\-only role in which you no longer produce. It is not for someone who uses AI to generate generic copy and calls that leverage, who needs the founders to supply every angle and mechanism, who waits to be told which test to run, or who blames media buying, design or development without investigating the full funnel.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

**Why choose AstraZeneca Spain?**
---------------------------------


AstraZeneca Spain is a rising force in our global business. With headquarters in Madrid and our global hub in Barcelona, we’ve become an important international centre of excellence in the fight against critical disease. Boasting vibrant universities and business schools, the Barcelona ecosystem is a place where scientists can thrive. We invite you to bring your talents to Barcelona where our respiratory medicine R\&D and Global Marketing centre offers opportunities in R\&D, IT, Commercial and HR. Or join us in Madrid and shape our growth in our BUs (Respiratory, Oncology \& CVRM ), and a range of Corporate functions. Additionally, you can find sales roles throughout the country. Together, we’re contributing to a world\-leading pipeline of therapeutics and delivering life\-changing medicines to patients.


**Who do we look for?**
-----------------------


Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca Spain, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. Alongside technical expertise, colleagues have the resilience, energy and collaborative mindset to change lanes, work with different teams and start projects from scratch.


Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting\-edge technology. Whether you join us in Madrid or Barcelona, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.


**Success Profile**
-------------------


Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth\-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.


### **Diverse collaborators**


This is a speak\-up culture that values collaboration. You’ll proactively bring your unique perspectives, experiences and skills to the table and seek the same from others. With our international team composition and the need for fast\-paced collaboration, you’ll always be building new connections with colleagues.


### **Cutting\-edge innovators**


When you join us, you’ll be part of a team that embraces digital technology and data to transform the way we work and the work we do. Every day, you’ll help make history, empowered to ignite your creativity and build something enduring.


### **Resilient trailblazers**


Here, the answers aren’t always available. So, you’ll need to bring a fearless, self\-starter mindset to navigate uncharted territories. You’ll harness your ceaseless energy to discover and make the necessary connections with colleagues to shape the future and achieve maximum impact.


### **Agile movers**


Seize ownership and excel with autonomy to enjoy the constant rush of ground\-breaking discovery. Your ability to anticipate sudden shifts and adapt swiftly will prove critical as you make your mark in an environment that rewards initiative and resilience.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Job ID** R\-259127 **Date posted** 08/31/2026
**Location**: Barcelona \- Spain (3 days working from the office and 2 days working from home)


**Introduction to role**


BioPharmaceuticals Medical (BPM) ensures the best patient outcomes by providing healthcare decision\-makers around the world with the evidence and confidence they need on AstraZeneca therapies and support our internal stakeholders with medical insight and expertise. BPM provides medical leadership with market participation and connectivity while also impacting the life cycle planning and execution of all our products. BPM aims to lead AstraZeneca in achieving scientific leadership, being a great place to work, and keeping patients at the core of everything we do.


The Senior Director, Health Data Implementation is part of the Global BPM Evidence organization; reporting directly to the Head, Real World Science \& Analytics. This critical role will lead the design and delivery of world\-class, innovative real world data (RWD) initiatives to be implemented globally for field medical teams, cross\-functional partners and AstraZeneca country affiliates. Platforms that integrate contemporary, location\-relevant RWD from primary, secondary, and tertiary care settings will be a key focus.


The incumbent will be accountable for the development and implementation of these RWD platforms to deliver Medical, Commercial, Policy, and R\&D strategies for AstraZeneca across therapeutic areas. The role requires interaction with diverse range of scientific, technical, and business experts to ensure scientific quality, build the necessary capabilities at AstraZeneca, and drive the timely delivery of RWD to address critical evidence needs for internal and external stakeholders. Externally, the Senior Director, Health Data Implementation will collaborate with health systems, data custodians and policy makers on partnerships that maximize our collective ability to leverage RWD to change clinical practice.


The Senior Director, Health Data Implementation will be accountable for chairing RWD steering committees and hold a key role on cross\-functional working groups that will link RWD platforms to enterprise strategy. This exciting role will further lead cross\-functional strategy, planning, alignment, governance and delivery of RWD solutions – ensuring optimal reach and impact in line with program objectives and KPIs. The role will work closely with the Global and local cross\-functional teams to successfully deliver and pioneer RWD platforms around the world. The Senior Director, Health Data Implementation will further assist in advancing and crafting AZ’s RWD strategy through supporting due diligence on new data providers/vendors, informatics support for data acquisitions, and use cases for RWD across therapeutic areas and functional areas.


**Typical Accountabilities**


* Lead the implementation of RWD platforms across countries, while supporting their design and development in collaboration with IT and other partners

description:
Location: Barcelona, Spain Job reference: R\-259410 Date posted: 09/07/2026
**Why This Role Is Crucial Now**


ElevateCX is shifting gear from strategy into action across EUCAN \& International. The programme's success now depends on **execution excellence**, with significant focus on activating local brand teams and evolving ways of working, alongside closer collaboration with global teams to provide stronger above\-market support to countries.


**This Is What You Will Do**


You will be the execution engine of ElevateCX at EUCAN \& Int, reporting to the Commercial Excellence Lead, EUCAN \& International. Your mandate has four pillars: **activate and continuously support local brand teams** to to create Cx journeys and engage customers differently; **support the shaping of ElevateCX strategy while strengthening above market alignment**; and **embed agentic AI** wherever it adds value — moving the region from AI\-assisted to AI\-orchestrated CX execution. You will design, deploy, and govern agentic AI solutions that automate and personalise customer engagement across owned channels, acting as the regional bridge between global AI capabilities and market\-level execution. You will operate as the connective tissue between global marketing, medical and IT, the ElevateCX programme, and local commercial and medical teams across EUCAN \& International — turning strategic intent into adopted, measurable, compliant customer experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.


**You Will Be Responsible For**


**1\. Activating and Continuously Supporting Local Brand Teams to Engage Differently**


Lead the change management that accelerates markets' adoption of ElevateCX and the delivery of differentiated customer experience with a data\-first mindset. This is about **embedding** new ways of working so local brand teams actually adopt them — not just recognise them.


* **Design and drive the market activation following ElevateCX Action Plan aligned** with the customer engagement strategy: structured change plans per market, champion networks, adoption milestones, and hands\-on support that takes brand teams and field force from awareness to sustained new ways of working.
* **Move markets from one\-size\-fits\-all campaigns to personalised CX journeys** built on C360 and segmentation — coaching local marketing and medical teams (in line with the ElevateCX competence framework) to translate disease strategic plans into tailored CX journeys, segment HCPs, fully leverage C360, CX Journey Production Hub, emerging agentic AI solutions and capture voice of customer.
* **Unlock capabilities and co\-own the training approach**: partner with Commercial Excellence Lead and Global Training Teams (commercial and medical) on the design and rollout of the regional training and capability\-building programme
* Establish and run **Cx Journey Production Hub** governance across multiple stakeholders involved
* Own the relationship **external vendors** behind the Cx journey platform (SFMC), and **work closely with the Business Systems Team and RDU IT** to define business requirements and use cases, prioritise the roadmap against ElevateCX and market needs
* **Establish and run best\-practice sharing routines across the region** (digital leads sessions, monthly Ops meetings, support EUCAN \& Int roadshows) and measure adoption with leading indicators, acting decisively on resistance and gaps.

**2\. Supporting CX Strategy \& Strengthening above market collaboration between EUCAN \& Int and global teams**


Support the Commercial Excellence Lead, EUCAN \& International with the continuous evolution of ElevateCX strategy, while driving stronger alignment with global teams.


* Contribute to the definition and evolution of CX and omnichannel strategy, engagement models, and strategic frameworks that are actionable at market level.
* Act as a fundamental part of shaping **global marketing, medical, and IT alignment** with ElevateCX strategy — representing regional and market realities in global forums and influencing global roadmaps and content plans.
* Create clear ways of working between global, regional, and local teams that maximise ElevateCX and above\-market support for global teams, reducing fragmentation and duplicated effort.
* Maintain and evolve the CX governance framework, decision criteria, and prioritisation mechanisms for CX and omnichannel initiatives.
* Stay current with industry trends, competitor CX maturity, and emerging technologies (AI\-driven personalisation, next\-best\-action, modular content) to inform strategy evolution, and contribute to CX success metrics at experience and journey level.

**3\. Embedding Agentic AI Across CX Execution**


Focus on incorporating agentic AI in customer experience — constantly scanning where AI agents add value, and turning that into working solutions.


* Design and deploy AI agents (**Microsoft Copilot Studio**) that automate campaign operations across SFMC, web, and social — e.g., content adaptation and localisation, campaign QA, consent verification, performance reporting — with human\-in\-the\-loop review at defined decision points.
* Support defining the **agentic operating model** for regional CX execution: which tasks agents own, where escalation to humans is required, and how outputs are validated before HCP\-facing use.
* Own **governance of agentic workflows** in line with compliance requirements (GDPR, HCP consent, promotional review), partnering with legal/compliance and IT.
* Build market capability: train local brand and medical teams to work with agent\-supported workflows, and act as adoption champion for AI\-enabled ways of working.
* Contribute regional use cases and learnings to the **AI 2030 roadmap**, prioritising by value, feasibility, and compliance risk, in partnership with RDU IT and global AI teams.

**You Will Need to Have**


* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in omnichannel marketing, digital engagement, customer experience, or commercial excellence within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Proven, hands\-on experience as a business owner or power user of marketing and digital engagement platforms — **Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Adobe (Experience Cloud), Sitecore, and AWS\-based digital services** — plus social media channel management in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated **change management experience**: driving adoption of new ways of working across brand teams or markets, not only designing frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience **building and deploying AI agents** in Microsoft Copilot Studio or an equivalent platform (e.g., Agentforce) — you have built and shipped something agentic, not only used AI tools.
* Demonstrated use of generative AI in marketing operations, and a clear understanding of **human\-in\-the\-loop design** and why it matters in a regulated industry.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial models, HCP engagement strategies, consent management, and regulatory/privacy considerations (GDPR).
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment in matrixed, cross\-functional organisations spanning global, regional, and local levels.
* Experience working across multiple geographies and translating global strategies into local execution.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and storytelling skills; analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into decisions.
* Fluent in English.

**We Would Prefer for You to Have**


* Experience in rare disease or specialty care commercial models
* Experience with impactful training and capability\-building programmes for marketing/medical teams.
* Familiarity with the Veeva/ Salesforce ecosystem (CRM) and CDPs/C360\-type customer data platforms.
* Experience with agentic patterns such as multi\-agent workflows and RAG over approved content libraries.
* Experience defining AI governance or decision\-rights frameworks.
* Vendor and IT partnership management experience (business requirements, roadmaps, delivery oversight).
* Additional European languages.

**Why Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease**


At Alexion, work isn't ordinary. As leaders in rare disease, our closeness to patients brings us closer to our work and to each other. Joining Alexion means combining the agility and pioneering spirit of a focused rare disease business with the scale, investment, and career opportunities of AstraZeneca. In this role you will directly shape how thousands of healthcare professionals across EUCAN \& International experience our company — and, through them, how patients with rare diseases are found, diagnosed, and treated.

title: Lead Java/Kotlin/AI Engineer
description:
European Union
  
  

**Work type:**  

Office/Remote
  
  

**Technical Level:**  

Leader
  
  

**Job Category:**  

Software Development
  
  

**Project:**  

American multinational e\-commerce company
  
  

N\-iX is looking for Lead Java/Kotlin/AI Engineer to join the team
  
  

Our client, headquartered in California, is a global e\-commerce leader connecting millions of buyers and sellers in over 190 markets. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role focused on shaping, building, and scaling advanced AI systems at one of the world’s most established and heavily trafficked ecommerce platforms.
  
  

You will be expected to provide strong technical leadership through architecture, design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, technical strategy, cross\-team influence, and hands\-on execution.
  
  

**About the Role:**  

As a Lead Engineer, you will work across the full AI lifecycle: early exploration, rapid prototyping, system design, model and agent integration, evaluation, experimentation, production deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.
  
  

Your focus will include Generative AI systems, LLM\-powered applications, intelligent agents, conversational AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and multi\-agent architectures. You will help define the technical direction for key AI initiatives while directly working on sophisticated engineering work.
  
  

This role requires deep hands\-on engineering ability, strong architectural judgment, AI systems expertise, and the ability to lead through influence rather than formal authority. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, making pragmatic tradeoffs, influencing senior partners, and helping teams turn ambitious AI ideas into durable production systems.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Lead the architecture, design, development, and optimization of scalable AI systems using Generative AI, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, and agent\-based architectures.
  
Serve as the technical owner or technical lead for high\-impact AI initiatives that span multiple services, systems, teams, or product surfaces.
  
Design and build agent\-led user experiences and backend systems that leverage task decomposition, memory, tool use, dynamic planning, retrieval, workflow orchestration, and multi\-agent coordination.
  
Translate ambiguous business, research, and product opportunities into clear technical strategies, architecture proposals, implementation plans, milestones, risks, and tradeoffs.
  
Drive architectural decisions for AI\-powered products and platforms, ensuring systems are reliable, maintainable, scalable, cost\-effective, observable, and production\-ready.
  
Contribute directly to complex implementation work across backend services, AI orchestration layers, model integration systems, evaluation frameworks, APIs, data pipelines, and observability tooling.
  
Partner with Product, Research, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Software Engineering teams to align AI system design with user needs, business goals, platform capabilities, and operational constraints.
  
Establish and promote technical standards for AI system design, agent architecture, LLM integration, evaluation, experimentation, responsible AI, production monitoring, and operational excellence.
  
Lead design reviews, architecture reviews, code reviews, technical planning sessions, and production\-readiness reviews for complex AI systems.
  
Mentor and guide engineers through technical problem solving, design feedback, implementation support, code quality improvements, and knowledge sharing.
  
Help advance the internal GenAI platform by contributing reusable components, APIs, frameworks, reference architectures, evaluation patterns, engineering guidelines, and shared services.
  
Define and improve AI evaluation practices, including offline evaluation, online experimentation, regression testing, model behavior analysis, quality measurement, human feedback loops, and production feedback mechanisms.
  
Monitor and optimize AI systems in production for latency, quality, scalability, reliability, availability, cost efficiency, safety, and responsible AI use.
  
Identify technical risks early and drive practical mitigation plans across architecture, implementation, launch, and operations.
  
Influence technical strategy across teams by aligning engineering decisions with broader organizational goals, platform direction, and long\-term scalability.
  
Stay ahead of advances in AI, LLMs, machine learning engineering, AI agents, retrieval systems, model serving, evaluation tooling, and emerging developer frameworks, applying a pragmatic lens to production adoption.
  
Drive continuous improvement across design, implementation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and operational processes.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

10\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, AI engineering, distributed systems, or related technical roles.
  
3\+ years of experience leading complex technical initiatives, setting architecture, mentoring engineers, or providing technical direction across teams.
  
Deep hands\-on engineering skills, with the ability to personally design and implement complex production systems.
  
Strong programming skills in Java, Kotlin or similar JVM languages
  
Experience designing and operating production\-grade AI systems, distributed services, APIs, or platform components that serve high\-volume, real\-world user traffic.
  
Ability to lead technical discussions, evaluate tradeoffs, influence senior partners, and communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical collaborators.
  
**Hands\-on experience with:** Spring Framework, Reactive Programming, Docker and Kubernetes, Distributed systems and scalable backend services, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, or other service/API patterns, Production monitoring, observability, alerting, incident response, and performance optimization, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment practices, and operational support
  
Excellent English communication skills
  
  

**Nice to have:**

description:
**Company Description**  

NIQ is standing up a new PM Operations \& AI Enablement group: a small, build\-weighted internal product team that creates AI\-powered tools for our product organization and drives the adoption that makes them land. We are looking for the Lead Product Manager who will own that portfolio end to end.


This is a product management role, not a coordination role. You will carry a portfolio of internal products with real users, a measured quality bar, adoption targets and sunset decisions — and you will own the operating practices that make our product teams faster and better evidenced. Think of it as being the product manager for the product managers.


You will lead a cross\-functional group of engineers without direct reporting lines, which means you will deliver through shared goals, written agreements and visible artifacts rather than instruction. We are explicit about this because it shapes who succeeds here.


The two pilots are an AI toolchain for the software development lifecycle, and our design system.

 **Job Description**  

Strategy and portfolio


– The group’s product vision, direction and strategy for a 12–18 month roadmap: what gets built, in what order, and why.


– Portfolio prioritization and capacity allocation, including how many tools the group can responsibly carry at once.


– The build\-versus\-buy recommendation for every initiative, against a buy\-or\-configure\-first default, and the business case behind it.


– The sunset decision for tools that do not earn their adoption.


– A two\-to\-three year view of how AI changes product and engineering work, and a roadmap that stays consistent with it.


Building AI products


– End\-to\-end product definition for the group’s AI tooling: problem, users, the workflow it replaces, the adoption path, the measurement plan, the maintenance owner.


– AI\-native specifications a strong engineer can build from — task boundaries, context sources, failure modes, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop points, and the quality bar in numbers.


– The product calls that shape the architecture: workflow versus agent, retrieval versus fine\-tuning, model selection per use case, and the cost and latency budget.


– The quality bar and evaluation strategy: what "good enough" means before the build starts, a failure taxonomy built from real usage, and the regression discipline when prompts or models change.


– How the human enters the loop, how uncertainty is shown, and what happens when the system does not know — the decisions that determine whether people trust the tool.


– The incident and rollback plan for non\-deterministic failure, written before launch.

  

Adoption


– The adoption outcome, measured as instrumented depth of use — not seats provisioned or enthusiasm in a demo.


– The adoption path for each tool: pilot teams, a champion in each team, onboarding, office hours, handover to support.


– Evangelizing the work across product and engineering: the demo, the prototype, the case made repeatedly and well.


– Facilitating the sessions where practice actually changes and leaving them with commitments rather than sentiment.


– Change management, rollout, training and enablement content.


– Honest reconciliation of instrumented usage against self\-reported benefit, and ownership of the gap.


Practice and craft


– The product operating standards for the organization — intake, prioritization inputs, PRD conventions, definition of done, documentation, decision log — kept deliberately light.


– Coaching and mentoring product managers, particularly those earlier in their careers, in continuous discovery, outcome framing, evidence\-based decision\-making and AI\-native practice.


– The AI literacy curriculum for the product organization — designed and taught or outsourced.


– Recurring forums where teams share what they discovered and what they decided.


Measurement and reporting


– The definition, baseline and instrumentation for the programme’s success metrics, quantitative and qualitative.


– A metric\-led reporting cadence to senior leadership, including the results that did not work.


– The trade\-off framework — speed, reliability, cost, data risk — communicated in writing.


Governance partnership


– The product\-side data decisions: what data each surface accepts, which model serves which use case, and the guardrails that go with it.


– Partnership with Legal, Privacy, Security and IT on data classification, model approval, access and responsible\-AI standards.

 **Qualifications**  

Required


– Senior product leadership experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, with end\-to\-end ownership from discovery through delivery, and the ability to show what changed as a result.


– Experience leading and growing cross\-functional teams, and mentoring product and design practitioners.


– Demonstrated ability to deliver through people who do not report to you — with concrete examples of aligning stakeholders who had different priorities, and of moving an organization to a new way of working that stuck.


– Hands\-on experience designing and shipping generative or agentic AI capabilities in a live product — not only using AI tools to accelerate your own work.


– Working fluency in AI product practice: prompt and context design, retrieval, agentic workflow patterns, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and model evaluation. You can discuss model trade\-offs, data requirements, cost and latency with engineers without needing first\-principles explanations.


– Experience defining what "good enough" means for an AI feature in measurable terms, and holding a product to it. – Experience creating or scaling a design system and driving its adoption across teams.


– Strong research and evidence practice: usability testing, interviews, journey mapping, surveys, A/B testing — run to a professional standard and taught to others.


– Strong customer research and evidence practice: conducting interviews and gathering insights for creating informed decisions.


– Product analytics fluency (for example Amplitude, Pendo, Tableau) and the quantitative literacy to define a metric that survives scrutiny.


– Experience defining and embedding operating practice — design ops, product ops, intake, process and documentation standards — that teams adopted willingly.


– Facilitation skills with senior and skeptical audiences, and experience designing and delivering enablement or training programmes.


– Commercial judgement: business\-case creation, budget ownership, and vendor or partner evaluation.


– Excellent written communication: you make your case in a document that survives the meeting you were not in.


– Fluent English


Preferred


– Formal grounding in AI product development


– Experience with agentic development tooling in your own workflow, and a view on what it changes about how teams work.


– Familiarity with engineering productivity measurement (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4\) and clear views on what each does and does not measure.

– Working knowledge of AI governance obligations in the EU and beyond, including AI literacy requirements for internal AI use.
