 We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of Ford Motor Company, as part of a global organization with exceptional colleagues in world\-class facilities. As part of
 **Ford Design** 
 , you’ll be at the cutting edge of Ford’s most strategically critical work, designing people and society’s needs into the heart of our next generation of products, services, and experiences.
   

  

***The Studio X Digital Design Chief reports to the Director of Design Operations and leads Design Visualization, Research \& Development, and Digital Technologies globally. This leader defines the strategic digital roadmap for the Global Design organization while ensuring operational excellence, rigorous data security, and high\-performing team management.***
**Responsibilities**
**What you'll do...**
**Strategic Leadership \& Digital Transformation**
* Digital Roadmap: Define and execute a long\-term global digital support strategy and transformation roadmap to enhance creativity and efficiency across Global Design.
* Emerging Tech \& AI: Evaluate and implement emerging digital tools, including AI, procedural workflow automation, and immersive technologies (AR/VR/MR).
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner with Program teams, Engineering, IT, Corporate Security, and Marketing to align digital initiatives with brand vision and future product strategies.


**Digital Production \& Visualization**
* End\-to\-End Pipelines: Oversee high\-fidelity rendering, narrative animation, real\-time visualization, and immersive digital simulation pipelines.
* Media Services: Manage comprehensive photography (including drone and documentary) and professional videography/editing services for the Design studio.
* Quality \& Delivery: Establish and enforce rigorous quality standards and review processes to ensure on\-time delivery of all Studio X assets.
* Executive Presentation: Support Marketing and Strategy teams with Executive Leadership Team (ELT) presentations and Market Research stimuli; confidently pitch and facilitate project reviews for senior leadership.


**Operations, Budget, \& IT Asset Management**
* Hardware Lifecycle: Manage procurement, maintenance, and lifecycles for high\-performance workstations, AR/VR head\-mounted displays, MicroLED displays, printers, and data management systems.
* Software \& SaaS: Oversee software licensing, SaaS usage, vendor negotiations, enterprise agreements, and corporate compliance.
* ROI Optimization: Ensure maximum ROI on all hardware and software acquisitions through pipeline automation and licensing efficiencies.


**Data Governance \& Studio Security**
* IP Protection: Implement data governance and security protocols for design imagery and highly sensitive, pre\-production data.
* Access Control: Create, implement, and enforce strict physical access\-control policies for all secure design studios and spaces.


**People Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Culture \& Performance: Foster a highly collaborative, accountable, and engaged studio culture. Lead OKR/KPI development and performance management.
* HR \& Personnel Management: Assist the Design Operations Director with personnel programs, including performance reviews, salary planning, employee counseling, and training plans.
* Mentorship \& Coaching: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, and mentor team members through complex, ambiguous challenges.


**Qualifications**
**You'll have...**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Transportation Design, Industrial Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 10\+ years in Automotive Design, high\-end product visualization, or digital design (in\-studio program experience preferred).
* Project Management: Proven experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder multimedia projects and budgets.
* Technical Expertise: Extensive knowledge of modern digital tools, hardware, data governance, IP protection, and the overall Product Development/Design process.
* Leadership: Strong business acumen with demonstrated leadership skills in hiring, developing, and inspiring creative technical teams.


**Even better, you may have...**
* Prior experience working within large, complex corporate environments and creative cultures.
* Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and global automotive design trends.
* Proven track record of presenting to and influencing executive\-level audiences.

As a key member of the ComputerCare People Operations team, the Director of Recruiting owns the full recruiting lifecycle across technical, operational, and customer\-facing roles. This position is responsible for building strong talent pipelines and partnering closely with hiring leaders to support the company’s rapid growth.

The Director of Recruiting plays a critical role in helping ComputerCare scale while maintaining our commitment to exceptional service, accountability, and teamwork. Success in this role requires strong operational discipline, proactive sourcing, and the ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously while delivering an outstanding candidate experience.



This role supports approximately **70\+ annual hires**, requiring the ability to manage **10–20 active requisitions simultaneously** while maintaining strong candidate experience and hiring quality. Most requisitions are hourly, technician\-level field and repair roles that require continual pipeline replenishment; a smaller number are salaried technical, operational, and leadership hires that require a more strategic, consultative approach, including occasional roles supporting ComputerCare’s teams in Ireland, Singapore, and India.


**Values in Action**



We instead of me. Be accountable. Take initiative. Act with empathy. Embrace curiosity. Do the right thing.



The Director of Recruiting models and reinforces ComputerCare’s values through the hiring process by:


* Delivering a service\-oriented candidate experience that reflects the company’s commitment to customers and employees.
* Demonstrating integrity and accountability in hiring practices and candidate evaluation.
* Partnering with hiring managers to ensure hiring decisions reflect the collaborative culture of ComputerCare.
* Continuously improving recruiting processes to support the company’s growth and operational excellence.

### **What You'll Do**

**Essential Duties**


* Manage full\-cycle recruiting across multiple departments, including Repair, IT, Sales, and Operations. Spans both high\-volume hourly/field hiring and salaried technical, operational, and leadership searches.
* Maintain an active pipeline of qualified candidates to support ongoing hiring needs.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, success profiles, and hiring plans aligned with company growth.
* Drive an efficient recruiting process that balances hiring speed with candidate quality.
* Manage communication and scheduling throughout the candidate journey to ensure a positive experience.
* Track key recruiting metrics (e.g., time\-to\-fill, pipeline conversion, source effectiveness) to improve hiring outcomes and share insights with leadership.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for sourcing and screening on assigned requisitions, ensuring candidates are evaluated and represented consistently before being introduced to hiring managers or executive leadership.
* Own and independently present a standing recruiting update to the Executive Leadership Team, translating pipeline and hiring data into resourcing recommendations.
* Maintain a high level of confidentiality and discretion regarding all matters, data and documents.
* Ensure the hiring process reflects ComputerCare’s commitment to service, integrity, and professionalism.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Maintain and update job descriptions and specifications to reflect evolving organizational needs and attract the right talent.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for frequently hired roles including repair technicians, IT support, sales, and operations positions.
* Manage requisition workflow, interview coordination, and offer processes to maintain hiring velocity.
* Provide hiring leaders with market insight regarding compensation, talent availability, and competitive trends.
* Conduct reference checks as needed to confirm the suitability and integrity of potential hires.
* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies using job boards, referrals, professional networks, and other proactive channels.
* Represent ComputerCare professionally in community and industry events to strengthen the company’s reputation as an employer.
* Organize and participate in career fairs, networking events, and community initiatives, representing the company and building a strong talent pipeline.
* Stay informed on industry trends and labor market conditions to maintain a competitive recruiting strategy.
* Screen candidates for technical capability and cultural alignment, ensuring a structured and equitable selection process.
* Provide training and coaching to hiring managers on interview techniques, candidate evaluation, and best practices for delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
* Maintain accurate, organized data within the applicant tracking system (ATS). ComputerCare’s system of record is Lever.
* Collaborate with HR and business leaders to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) in all recruiting practices.
* Support the facilitation of new hire orientation sessions and onboarding activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned by leadership.

  




### **What You'll Bring**

* 7\-10 years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, ideally within a physical asset management, field services, or multi\-site operations environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage **10–20 concurrent requisitions** in a fast\-paced environment.
* Comfortable partnering with, and when necessary, respectfully challenging, senior leadership and hiring managers on role scope, sourcing channels, and candidate quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven ability to source and engage candidates across multiple platforms.
* Experience partnering with hiring managers and influencing hiring decisions.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills; able to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on relationship\-building and candidate care.
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ComputerCare’s system of record is Lever) and sourcing tools (e.g., LinkedIn Recruiter).
* Experience recruiting across technical and non\-technical roles is a plus!

### **What does success look like?**

* Maintaining strong candidate pipelines for critical roles
* Achieving recruiting timelines that support operational needs
* Delivering a professional and responsive candidate experience
* Building trusted partnerships with hiring managers, and proactively building relationships across the executive team within the first 90 days
* Contributing to continuous improvement of recruiting practices
* Delivering a standing, ELT\-ready recruiting report independently

### **Perks \& Benefits**

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to keep you feeling your best
* 401(k) with employer match—because your future matters
* Company\-paid Life Insurance, plus HSA \& FSA options
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for real support when you need it
* Adoption Assistance to help grow your family
* Commuter Benefits for an easier ride
* Free Coursera Professional Certifications to level up your skills
* Generous vacation \& sick time, plus paid time off to give back to your community

If you get to this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job you just read. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in ComputerCare’s mission, core values and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways – not just candidates who check all the boxes.

At ComputerCare, we welcome passionate individuals who have the unrestricted right to work in the United States, including natural citizens and Green Card holders.

ComputerCare is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director Design, Product Design & AI (m/f/d)
description:
#### **This is Edenspiekermann**


We are Edenspiekermann, an independent design consultancy with 40\+ years of experience helping world\-leading organizations invent, build, and evolve their products.


Our interaction designers work in agile and interdisciplinary teams on websites and platforms for major brands as well as for startups. Our teams combine conceptual thinking, a sophisticated understanding of design and a deep knowledge of web and app development to develop a digital product or service with a user\-centric approach. In doing so, we advise and coach our clients' teams to provide the best customer experience for their customers.

#### **Description**


We are looking for a hands\-on Design Director to join our US team in a permanent, remote\-first role based in Southern California. You will work primarily from home and be available to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require. You will lead complex digital\-product and design\-system engagements across our portfolio, including work in regulated industries and global medical technology. AI will be a core part of how you explore, prototype, make decisions, and help teams deliver better work.  

This is a senior client\-facing role for someone who is excited by how AI is changing design and product development. You will set direction, stay close to the work, and help clients move from isolated experiments to useful AI\-enabled products, workflows, and operating models. You will combine curiosity and speed with strong judgment about where human craft, review, and accountability matter.

#### **Your Tasks**

* Lead client engagements end\-to\-end, from initial framing and design direction through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Translate user needs, business goals, brand intent, accessibility, engineering, content, and compliance requirements into clear product and system direction.
* Own the design quality of the work, balancing strategic clarity with strong visual, interaction, and systems\-design craft.
* Direct the creation and evolution of scalable Figma libraries, component architectures, variables, tokens, themes, patterns, prototypes, and documentation.
* Work closely with product and engineering leaders to connect design decisions with production code, release processes, and measurable product outcomes.
* Establish practical governance and contribution models that support distributed teams without overloading a small central group.
* Facilitate workshops and decision\-making with senior stakeholders across design, product, engineering, research, content, and compliance.
* Guide multidisciplinary teams, coach designers, set a high bar for craft, and give clear, constructive direction.
* Make AI part of the design practice every day, using it for research synthesis, ideation, content, prototyping, design\-system work, and design\-to\-code exploration.
* Prototype AI\-enabled product experiences, including conversational, adaptive, generative, and agentic interactions, then test whether they create meaningful value for people.
* Experiment quickly with new tools and models, share what works, and help the team build repeatable AI workflows instead of one\-off demos.
* Evaluate AI output critically and establish practical guardrails for quality, accessibility, privacy, approved source material, human review, and accountability.
* Help shape Edenspiekermann's AI\-enabled product and design\-systems practice, contributing to how we pitch, deliver, and talk about the work.
#### **Your profile**

* You have at least 8 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or design systems, including several years leading complex client or enterprise engagements.
* Your portfolio demonstrates systems thinking, refined visual craft, shipped digital products, and credible AI\-enabled work.
* You have led design systems across multiple products, platforms, brands, or teams and understand how they connect to Figma libraries, production code, documentation, versioning, and engineering adoption.
* You have experience in a regulated or high\-accountability environment and treat accessibility as a system requirement.
* You can lead senior client conversations, facilitate difficult decisions, and turn ambiguity into a practical path forward with curiosity, judgment, and a collaborative, low\-ego attitude.
* You actively use generative and agentic AI in your own practice, can demonstrate workflows beyond surface\-level prompting, and can separate useful applications from hype.
* You communicate fluently in English and are comfortable collaborating across US and European teams.
* You are based in Southern California, willing and able to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require, and legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
#### **We Offer**

* A permanent, full\-time, remote\-first role with a central place in our US design team.
* The annual salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
* A defined contribution toward medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus access to a healthcare FSA.
* A 401(k) plan with a 2% company match and eligibility for a discretionary year\-end bonus based on company performance.
* A flexible PTO policy, with time off coordinated around client and team commitments, plus eleven paid holidays, a year\-end office closure, monthly internet and wellness stipends, and professional\-development support.
* The opportunity to lead visible, strategically important product, design\-system, and AI\-enabled transformation engagements.
* An international portfolio and regular collaboration with colleagues across Europe and the United States.
* A high\-craft, low\-ego team with direct access to partners and senior leadership, real autonomy, constructive feedback, and space to shape how we work.
* A multidisciplinary team that is actively building AI into design, strategy, research, engineering, and delivery.
#### **We are pleased to meet you!**


We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity.

**If you are interested, please provide us with the following documents and information:**

* Current CV
* Portfolio with at least one substantial product or design\-system case and a credible AI\-enabled product or workflow example
* A short explanation of your role, decisions, measurable contribution, and how AI changed the work or outcome
* Earliest possible start date


One more thing, never fear to apply initiative. We understand: a lack of confidence can sometimes keep us from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as the perfect applicant. That's why we encourage you to apply to us.

title: AI Video & Content Creator
description:
*About Us* 




 Outsmart Labs is a Miami\-based content and marketing agency working with brands across fashion, real estate, hospitality, and consumer products. We’re rebuilding how we produce content around AI — not as a gimmick, but as a real production pipeline that can compete with (and beat) traditional video and photo shoots on speed, cost, and output.
 



  





*The Role* 




 We’re hiring a full\-time
 **AI Video \& Content Creator** 
 to build a genuinely high\-level AI content practice inside our agency. This isn’t about running a single prompt and calling it done — we’re looking for someone who can produce content indistinguishable from real production: photorealistic AI video and stills that clients (and their audiences) can’t tell apart from a traditional shoot.
 



 You’ll own AI\-generated content end to end — from concept through final asset — and you’ll build the tools, prompt libraries, and workflows that let our team use AI well, consistently, and at scale.
 



  





*What You’ll Do* 



* Produce fully AI\-generated video and photo content at a premium, “doesn’t look like AI” quality level
* Combine multiple AI tools/platforms into a single production pipeline (not relying on one tool alone) to hit that bar
* Build and rapidly iterate large volumes of ad creative — generating and testing many variations of a single concept quickly, so we can find what performs without burning production time on each version
* Develop reusable prompt workflows and internal processes/documentation so AI production becomes a repeatable, scalable part of how the team works — not a one\-off skill
* Partner with our Content Lead and creative team to translate campaign concepts and briefs into AI\-produced assets
* Stay ahead of the fast\-moving AI content tooling landscape and bring new capabilities into our workflow as they emerge
* Occasionally train/onboard team members on the tools and prompting techniques you develop



  





  





*What We’re Looking For* 



* Demonstrated portfolio of AI\-generated video/photo content at a high production\-value level — this is the most important requirement; we need to see the work
* Deep, current hands\-on knowledge of AI image and video generation tools and how to chain them together for polished output
* Strong prompt engineering skills — you can go from “the client wants X” to a working prompt/workflow quickly
* An eye for what makes content look real vs. obviously AI\-generated, and the technical know\-how to close that gap
* Experience producing content for social/digital ads is a plus — understanding what drives performance, not just what looks good
* Ability yo create ad creatives in bulk
* Process\-oriented: comfortable documenting workflows so they can be reused and taught, not just personal know\-how
* Comfortable in a fast\-moving agency environment with multiple clients and quick turnarounds



  





  





*Nice to Have* 



* Traditional video editing or photography background
* Experience building or customizing AI tooling/automations beyond off\-the\-shelf apps
* A track record of teaching or leading others on AI tools



  





  





 Portfolio link must be available in resume or LinkedIn profile.
 



 This position offers remote flexibility, but we prefer candidates currently located in the Miami area, as our office is based in downtown Miami.

title: Country Manager, Argentina
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent


**About The Team**
 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**
* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


 Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
   

  

**Other Stuff To Know**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Country Manager Argentina y Uruguay
description:
**QUIÉNES SOMOS**
**Quiénes somos:**
 Samsonite es el líder mundial en bolsos, equipaje y accesorios de viaje, que combinan un estilo notable con la última tecnología de diseño y la máxima atención a la calidad y durabilidad. Durante más de 100 años, Samsonite ha aprovechado su rica herencia para crear productos inigualables que satisfacen las necesidades de estilo de vida de viaje de los viajeros conscientes de todo el mundo. Con una cartera de marcas que incluye Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann y Lipault Paris, nuestros productos se venden en más de 100 países de América del Norte, Asia, Europa y América Latina a través de nuestras tiendas propias, sitios web y una variedad de socios minoristas
   

  

**DESCRIPCIÓN DE PUESTO**
**Misión**
* Dirigir y controlar las operaciones de Samsonite en Argentina y Uruguay, proporcionando la orientación y dirección estratégica necesarias para garantizar que la empresa alcance su misión y objetivos.


**Ubicación y Modalidad De Trabajo**
* Direccion oficina: Dr. Nicolas Repetto 3656, Piso 7, Olivos, Provincia de Buenos Aires.
* Modalidad de lunes a jueves presencial y viernes remoto.


**Principales Funciones**
* Formular e implementar con éxito la misión de la empresa en Argentina y Uruguay, es decir, estar presente y actuar activamente en las cuatro canales de venta estratégicas de la compañía: Retail, Wholesale, Franquicias y Negocios digitales (E\-commerce y Marketplaces). Samsonite en Argentina y Uruguay, se presenta a través de sus propias tiendas y franquicias. Complementar el negocio con un sólido comercio (retail, wholesale y franquicia) y digital en una fase de rápido crecimiento.
* Orientar la estrategia hacia el crecimiento rentable y el funcionamiento de la empresa dentro de las áreas de desempeño mencionadas anteriormente.
* Desarrollar planes de negocio estratégicos que reflejen los objetivos y prioridades a largo plazo establecidos por la Compañía para el mercado de Argentina y Uruguay.
* Asegurarse de que los objetivos operativos y los estándares de rendimiento no solo se comprendan, sino que también sean asumidos por el resto del equipo.
* Supervisar de cerca los resultados operativos y financieros en comparación con los planes y presupuestos, tomando medidas correctivas cuando sea necesario e informando a la gerencia sobre los cambios significativos.
* Asumir la plena responsabilidad de todas las operaciones de la empresa y representarla ante los principales clientes y socios comerciales. Adicionalmente, asegurar el cuidado de los gastos operacionales del funcionamiento de la compañía.
* Crear, desarrollar y mantener un equipo ejecutivo eficaz, dirigiendo y controlando el trabajo y los recursos de la empresa, y asegurando la contratación y retención del personal necesario, motivándolo, capacitándolo y desarrollándolo para garantizar que se alcancen la misión y los objetivos.
* Brindar asesoramiento y orientación estratégica a la gerencia para mantenerlos al tanto de las novedades del sector y garantizar el desarrollo de políticas adecuadas que cumplan con la misión y los objetivos de la empresa. Asimismo, se debe cumplir con todas las leyes y normativas pertinentes.
* Desarrollar y mantener programas de investigación y desarrollo para garantizar que la empresa se mantenga a la vanguardia del sector, aplique los métodos y enfoques más rentables, proporcione productos y servicios de última generación y mantenga su ventaja competitiva.
* Preparar, obtener la aprobación y supervisar la implementación del presupuesto anual para garantizar que se cumplan los objetivos, se maximicen los flujos de ingresos y se minimicen los costos fijos.
* Desarrollar y mantener una estrategia eficaz, con conjunto con la dirección regional de marketing, para promocionar los productos, marca e imagen de la empresa en la comunidad en general.
* Representar a la empresa en las negociaciones con clientes, proveedores y otros contactos clave para garantizar las condiciones contractuales más eficaces.
* Desarrollar y mantener sistemas de gestión de calidad total en toda la empresa para garantizar que se ofrezcan a los clientes los mejores productos y servicios posibles.
* Desarrollar y dirigir la implementación de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar que la empresa cumpla con todas las normas de salud, seguridad, normativa SOX y demás regulaciones legales.


**Requisitos**
* Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, deseable con MBA.
* 15 a 20 años de experiencia total
* 10 años de expeirnecia en liderazgo corporativo dentro de la industria de moda, retail y wholesale
* Sólidos conocimientos y experiencia en retail, whollesale y ecommerce
* Excel intermedio
* Deseable manejo de SAP
* Inglés fluido y español nativo


**ACERCA DEL EQUIPO**
**Por Qué Te Encantará Trabajar Aquí**
**Nuestros empleados importan.** 
 Como empresa centrada en las personas, trabajamos duro para ofrecer recompensas y oportunidades de desarrollo a nuestros empleados, reconociendo su rendimiento y creando un entorno de trabajo propicio para ellos, dondequiera que se encuentren.
   

  

**Cultura vibrante.** 
 Estamos comprometidos con una cultura diversa y rica, que acoge a personas de todas las profesiones y condiciones sociales. Nuestro compromiso de larga data con la diversidad y la inclusión nos permite aportar cada día al trabajo nuestro auténtico yo y nuestras diferencias únicas.
   

  

**Socialmente responsables.** 
 Queremos minimizar el impacto de nuestros productos en el medio ambiente y ayudar a crear viajes positivos en todo el mundo. Para ello, creamos los mejores productos utilizando los materiales, métodos y modelos más sostenibles e innovadores.
   

  

**Lo Que Valoramos**
 En Samsonite, hacemos más que crear las maletas que se mueven con nuestros clientes, inspiramos y celebramos los momentos que les mueven. Creemos que tenemos una responsabilidad con el mundo en cómo operamos, los productos que vendemos, las comunidades donde vivimos y trabajamos, y cómo tratamos a las personas que trabajan con nosotros. Somos tan diversos como los viajes mismos, y como los viajes, tu viaje con Samsonite presenta la oportunidad de formar parte de algo más grande y explorar tus pasiones. Por eso ofrecemos varios caminos para los profesionales y celebramos los conocimientos y habilidades que aportan a nuestro equipo. Estamos comprometidos con un lugar de trabajo respetuoso que permita a los miembros de nuestro equipo aportar diariamente lo mejor de sí mismos.
   

  

 Samsonite es una empresa que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y se compromete a promover y mantener un entorno de trabajo en el que todos los solicitantes, asociados, clientes y otras personas sean tratados con dignidad y respeto, libres de acoso, discriminación o represalias.

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

title: Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
Rite is one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East, making daily nutrition enjoyable through functional gummies and drink mixes.
 



 Founded in Dubai and now operating locally in Saudi Arabia, we're building much more than a supplement brand, we're creating a wellness ecosystem powered by content, community, education, and exceptional products.
 



 Rite is currently available online and in more than 300\+ stores.
 



 We're looking for an entrepreneurial marketing leader who wants to continue building a strong brand, not simply manage and execute.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 As our Marketing \& Growth Manager, you will own the execution of Rite's marketing strategy across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring every customer touchpoint \- from paid advertising and social media to CRM, influencers, and content \- works together to build a premium brand while driving profitable growth.
 



 Rather than executing every task yourself, your role is to lead internal and external partners, challenge ideas, improve creative quality, and make sure every initiative contributes to business growth.
 



 You'll work closely with the founders and become one of the key leaders shaping Rite's future.
 



  





**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Brand \& Creative Leadership** 



* Own Rite's brand positioning across all channels.
* Define the creative direction for advertising and organic content, both online and offline.
* Ensure consistency across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CRM, and the website.
* Challenge and improve every creative before production.
* Build a premium, recognizable wellness brand online and offline.



  





**Performance Marketing** 




 Work closely with our Media Buyer, UGC ads agency, and Creative Strategist by:
 


* Reviewing weekly performance.
* Identifying winning creative angles for the UAE and KSA markets.
* Defining testing priorities with our Creative Strategist and adapting them culturally to both countries.
* Ensuring creative production aligns with performance insights.
* Coordinating creative strategy with media buying.



  





**Content \& Social Media** 




 Own:
 


* Content calendar.
* Social strategy.
* Organic growth.
* Video production for product launches or specific campaigns.
* UGC planning.
* Community building.
* Brand storytelling.



 Coordinate with external UGC agencies and freelance creators.
 



 Manage our in\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive, who will support you with execution.
 



  





**Influencer Strategy** 




 Lead the entire influencer programme strategy by managing our Influencer \& Partnerships Manager and external agencies responsible for execution.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Supporting creator sourcing.
* Supporting negotiations.
* Leading the affiliate strategy and ecosystem.
* Leading the whitelisting strategy.
* Campaign execution.
* Performance reporting.



 Build long\-term relationships with creators across the UAE and Saudi Arabia and ensure that deliverables are properly executed by your team and external agencies.
 



  





**Partnerships \& Brand Activations** 




 Lead Rite's partnership strategy to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and community engagement.
 


* Develop co\-marketing campaigns and brand collaborations.
* Support our Brand Partnerships \& Sales Manager with brand activations, pop\-ups, sampling campaigns, and wellness events.
* Support the creation of packaging, PR boxes, and marketing collateral.
* Manage sponsorship opportunities and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Create partnerships that generate both commercial opportunities and long\-term brand equity.



  





**CRM \& Customer Retention** 




 Be the main point of contact for our CRM agency and support them with strategy and execution.
 



 Own:
 


* Email strategy.
* Customer journeys.
* Campaign calendar.
* Loyalty initiatives.
* Product launches.



  





**Agency Management** 




 Coordinate multiple external partners, including:
 


* Creative agencies.
* UGC agencies and UGC creators.
* Production companies.
* Influencer agencies.
* CRM agency.
* Freelancers, including video editors and graphic designers.



 Ensure everyone works toward the same objectives.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Manage and work closely with:
 


* Creative Strategist, remote.
* In\-house Graphic Designer.
* In\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive.
* Country Manager Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh.



 Create a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, speed, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**We're Looking for Someone Who...** 



* Has 3–5\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands.
* Has extensive experience in performance marketing, offline marketing, content, social media, and influencer management.
* Understands how strong marketing drives acquisition.
* Has managed multiple agencies and cross\-functional teams.
* Has deep knowledge of UAE and Saudi consumer behaviour.
* Understands influencer marketing beyond vanity metrics.
* Thinks commercially, not just creatively.
* Is highly organised and execution\-focused.
* Is proactive, curious, and constantly looking for better ways of doing things.
* Has strong skills in the use of AI to set up efficient systems and SOPs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**The Entrepreneurial Mindset We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions.
 



 We want someone who:
 


* Treats Rite as if it were their own company.
* Challenges existing ideas and proposes better ones.
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks.
* Is obsessed with customer experience and business growth.
* Moves fast, learns quickly, and embraces experimentation.
* Is comfortable wearing multiple hats.
* Makes decisions using both data and intuition.
* Inspires the team through energy, curiosity, and ambition.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A unique opportunity to build one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East from the inside.
* High ownership and autonomy, with the ability to shape our brand, growth strategy, and partnership ecosystem alongside the founders.
* A competitive salary complemented by a performance\-based bonus.
* The chance to recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing marketing team as the company scales.
* Exposure to multiple high\-growth markets, with a strong focus on the UAE and Saudi Arabia and future international expansion.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Company visa, comprehensive health insurance, annual flight ticket, generous annual leave, and the tools you need to perform at your best.
* Flexible working arrangements and the opportunity to travel to Saudi Arabia for key partnerships, product launches, retail activations, and industry events.
* Unlimited access to Rite products and the opportunity to help shape the future of wellness in the region.

**Park Chapel Christian Church \| Greenfield, Indiana**

Park Chapel Christian Church is looking for an experienced, highly organized, creative, and relational **Communications \& Events Director** to help us tell the story of what God is doing, create experiences that bring people together, and build the systems that move great ideas from concept to reality.

  

This isn't simply a graphic design or social media position.



We're looking for a **big\-picture thinker and strong executor** who can develop strategy, manage multiple projects, collaborate with ministry leaders, tell compelling stories, and make sure the details get done.

  

We're open to experienced professionals from communications, marketing, events, project management, public relations, hospitality, creative services, nonprofit leadership, and related fields who feel called to use their gifts to serve the local church.

**Communications \& Storytelling – 40%**  

Lead Park Chapel's church\-wide communications strategy and manage our website, app, email, social media, promotional calendar, brand, and digital presence. Help identify and tell stories of life change and ministry impact through written content, photography, video, social media, and other creative channels.

 **Events \& Ministry Logistics –30%**  

Help plan and coordinate major church\-wide events and support ministry\-specific events through strong timelines, registrations, facility coordination, communication, signage, vendors, volunteers, and logistics.

 **Systems \& Administration –20%**  

Help manage and improve the systems behind ministry including: Planning Center/Church Center, Breeze, forms, registrations, workflows, databases, and our church\-wide calendar.

Recruit and develop photographers, videographers, designers, content creators, and other volunteers who can help tell Park Chapel's story and execute events with excellence.

We don't expect you to walk in on Day One and know every part of this job.



During your first **4–6 months**, your primary focus will be **Communications**: learning Park Chapel, developing relationships, leading our communication platforms, and strengthening our strategy and systems.



Throughout your first year, you'll also have intentional opportunities to shadow and learn from a long\-tenured staff member who plans to retire in **September 2027**. It's an unusual opportunity to **lead immediately in your area of expertise while being given time to learn the rest of the role well!**

* Has a growing relationship with Jesus and loves the local church.
* Has **3–5\+ years of relevant professional experience**.
* Is an exceptional communicator and strong project manager.
* Can see the big picture without losing the details.
* Is creative, relational, organized, and highly accountable.
* Can manage multiple projects and priorities with minimal supervision.
* Enjoys collaborating with people and turning ideas into action.
* Is comfortable with digital communications, social media, websites, marketing, events, and contemporary technology.
* Is excited about developing volunteers and creative teams.
* Will become an active participant and member of Park Chapel.

  


**Previous professional church ministry experience is not required.**



A bachelor's degree in a related field is preferred, but significant professional experience may substitute for formal education.

 **Work Environment**



This is a full\-time **hybrid ministry position**, not a fully remote role.

  

Regular on\-campus presence is expected with flexibility to work on\-site or remotely with supervisor approval. Sunday morning presence is required for this role. Office is open Monday \- Thursday from 9:00 AM \- 4:00 PM.

  

Occasional evening and weekend responsibilities are part of the position due to church\-wide events, special services, weddings, funerals, and other ministry activities.

 **Portfolio Required**



Candidates should submit a résumé and **3–5 examples of relevant professional work**.



Your portfolio might include communication or marketing campaigns, social media, event promotion, websites, photography/video, graphic work, written communications, branding, project plans, or other work that demonstrates your ability to **communicate, organize, create, and execute**.



Church\-related work is not required.

Park Chapel Christian Church exists to **Follow Jesus and Make Him Known.**



We're looking for someone who wants to use their professional gifts to help us communicate that mission clearly, tell the stories of what God is doing, and create experiences that help people connect with Jesus and one another.

  

If you love Jesus, love people, tell great stories, and know how to make things happen, **we'd love to meet you.**

title: Roark Global Marketing Director
description:
**Who We Are**
 Roark is a premium Adventure Lifestyle brand. Working within the Outdoor, Surf, and Lifestyle channels and offering product that performs without jeopardizing style. Always inspired by the journey. Roark has a collaborative and fast\-paced environment where operational excellence directly supports brand growth and customer success.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Global Marketing Director leads the Roark marketing function across every channel and every market. You set the brand vision and you run the process that delivers it. This role requires both: a clear point of view on where the brand is going in the adventure\-lifestyle space and the operational command to get it there season after season.
   

  

 You own marketing's seat in the 18\-month GTM process, working alongside product, merchandising, planning and sales leaders. Every brand asset the company produces flows through your team and carries your approval: campaign, ECOM, owned retail, wholesale, media, social, PR and athlete. You are accountable for the quality of the work, the timing of the work, and the budget behind it.
   

  

 You lead a team of four: Marketing Manager, Art Director, a contract Community Manager, and an Athlete Manager. You report to the Founder and Chief Brand Officer, and you carry the brand strategy into the rooms where the commercial plan is set.
   

  

 We are looking for someone experience in brand marketing who has run a team, held an organization to a GTM calendar, directed campaign production, and can speak with equal command about DTC and Wholesale distribution. The seat rewards vision matched by command of the operating detail: a brand steward who holds a high creative bar, values the GTM process, develops the people who report to them, and has the credibility to lead peers who do not. Deep working knowledge of and credibility within the adventure travel, surf, run, climb and trail communities is essential to this role.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**
 Brand Vision and Strategy
   

  

* Own the Roark brand strategy: positioning, seasonal narrative, franchise focus, category priorities, and the consumer targets behind them. Translate strategy into a marketing plan the team and the business can execute.
* Set the annual and seasonal marketing plan against the commercial plan. Know the number each channel carries and build marketing behind it.
* Own the brand book and brand guidelines. Approve how Roark is expressed in every market, by every internal team, and by every external partner.
* Bring consumer, category and competitive insight into product and merchandising conversations early enough to influence the line.
* Evaluate opportunities against long term brand equity while managing near term revenue. gains


 GTM Leadership
   

  

* Own marketing's seat in the 18\-month GTM process. Represent marketing at every gate from line planning and adoption through sell in and consumer launch.
* Set and hold the seasonal GTM calendar. Approve the critical path, arbitrate conflicts between channels, and make the call when a date moves.
* Write and approve the seasonal go to market brief that creative, copy, ECOM, retail and sales all execute from.
* Lead seasonal kickoff and launch readiness reviews with product, merchandising, planning, sales, ECOM and retail leadership.
* Hold the organization accountable to the process. The GTM calendar is the operating document for the brand, not a marketing artifact.


 Brand Asset Creation and Omni Channel Distribution
   

  

* Own the creation of all Roark brand assets: seasonal campaign photography and film, product imagery, catalogs, look books, line sheets, account presentations, in store and window graphics, trade show and event materials.
* Manage the Art Director on creative output. Set the brief, review the work, approve the final. You are the last brand approval on everything that ships.
* Own asset distribution against the GTM calendar globally: media and press, social, PR, influencer and athlete, ECOM and site, email and SMS, paid, owned retail, wholesale partner portals, and drop ship partners.
* Own media relationships and the PR program. Set the earned media strategy and the seasonal press calendar, and approve the assets and messaging that go out.
* Own asset governance: naming conventions, rights and usage, versioning, and a single approved DAM library that every channel and partner pulls from.


 DTC Distribution
   

  

* Partner with ECOM leadership on the site and digital marketing plan: launch calendar, merchandising stories, email and SMS, paid media, and content built to convert.
* Own the brand layer of DTC. How the campaign shows up on site, in email, in social and in paid, and whether it reads as one brand.
* Own the owned retail marketing program: seasonal windows, retail pathway visuals and in store storytelling, floor set support, store communication, openings and local activation.
* Review DTC performance monthly with ECOM and retail, and carry what you learn into the next seasonal plan.


 Wholesale Distribution
   

  

* Own the seasonal sell in Playbook: line sheets, brand and category presentations, seasonal story decks, digital assets for account portals, showroom and sample support.
* Direct account facing marketing across Core specialty, wholesale accounts, drop ship, and International distribution: co\-op programs, shop in shops, POP and fixture programs, catalog placements, and partner asset submissions.
* Build marketing support around the prebook and at once rhythm, delivered ahead of every prebook window.
* Partner with sales leadership to connect marketing investment to sell in and sell thru, and place co\-op dollars where they move product.
* Govern how the brand is represented in partner channels, on partner sites, and in partner marketing.


 Team Leadership and Collaboration
   

  

* Lead, coach and develop the team: Marketing Manager, Art Director, contract Community Manager, and Athlete Manager. Set goals, run reviews, build growth paths.
* Direct the Community Manager on grassroots, event and community programming, and the Athlete Manager on the athlete and ambassador roster, contracts, seeding and content capture.
* Run the marketing operating rhythm and make sure decisions get made, documented and communicated the same week they are needed.
* Communicate up and across. Present the plan, the calendar and the results to the Founder and Chief Brand Officer and to department leaders in a form they can act on.
* Manage the marketing budget: build it, allocate it across brand, channel and market, defend it, and reconcile it monthly.
* Manage agency, vendor and freelance partners: scope, bid, contract and performance.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related discipline or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 8 years in brand marketing at a consumer brand in apparel, Outdoor, Surf or premium lifestyle, with real time at both the strategic and the executional level.
* Proven people leadership. You have built and led a marketing team, including creative talent, and you have managed contract and agency resources.
* Demonstrated ownership of a GTM process at brand scale. You have set a seasonal calendar and held an organization to it.
* Global Brand strategy experience: positioning, narrative, guidelines, and the discipline to keep a brand consistent across channels and markets.
* Creative and content production leadership. You have directed campaign photo and film production and taken brand assets through to delivery across every channel.
* Media, social and PR fluency: earned media strategy, press relationships, social and influencer programs, and athlete or ambassador programs.
* Command of both sides of distribution. DTC (ECOM and owned retail) and Wholesale (prebook and at once, sell in versus sell thru, Core specialty, Majors, co\-op, retailer asset requirements).
* Budget ownership at the department level: build, allocate, defend, reconcile.
* Excellent communication. You present clearly to a founder, CEO, brief clearly to a designer, and align peers who do not report to you.
* Proficiency with project management and creative operations tooling (Asana), B2B (Elastic), and DAM systems, Adobe Creative Suite files, and ECOM Shopify platforms.
* A high level of passion in the Outdoor lifestyle. You live in the world Roark builds product for: Adventure travel, surf, running, climbing, trail, and the culture around it.
* Actively seeks out AI\-enabled tools and emerging technologies, adapting quickly to leverage them for improved productivity, deeper insights, and more effective processes, while exercising sound judgment and maintaining compliance with organizational standards


**Preferred Qualifications**
* International, UK and EU, AUS market experience, and experience supporting international distribution partners.
* Experience at a brand with both a healthy DTC and wholesale business, and a process to balance them efficiently.
* Experience building or rebuilding a GTM process from a low base.
* Trade show and sales meeting production leadership.
* Experience managing an athlete or ambassador roster.


 How Success is Measured
   

  

 First 90 Days
   

  

* Current Brand strategy and the seasonal marketing plan understood and articulated, aligned with the Founder and Chief Brand Officer, CEO and understood by key department leaders.
* Marketing's role in the 18\-month GTM process documented, with clear gates, owners and deliverables.
* Team assessed, goals set, and any capability or capacity gaps identified with a plan to close them.
* Asset and channel audit complete, with gaps for the next two seasonal deliveries identified.


 First Year
   

  

* Seasonal campaigns delivered on time and on brand across every channel and market, measured against the published critical path.
* Sell in Playbook released ahead of every prebook window, with adoption from the sales team and accounts.
* Measurable growth in earned media, social and community engagement against a defined baseline.
* ECOM and owned retail receive campaign packages on a predictable schedule, 1\-3 months before every launch.
* Global marketing budget managed to plan, with clean monthly reconciliation.
* Team retention, and demonstrable growth in all four direct reports.
* Evolved Marketing strategy for H2 2028 and beyond articulated for GTM planning process.


 Location \& Office Structure: This is an in\-office hybrid position, mandatory 4 days per week in office in Irvine, CA with the option to work from home 1 day per week. Subject to change without notice as per company guidelines.
   

  

 Compensation: The salary range for this position is $150,000 to $180,000 plus opportunity for annual bonus; salary is based on the experience that you bring to the position.
   

  

**Benefits And Perks**
* Complimentary chef prepared breakfast and lunch provided Monday \- Thursday
* Generous product gift program and all brand discounts
* Company bonus program
* 5 year and 10 year Milestone Anniversary travel gifts
* Medical, Dental, Vision insurance in accordance with plan guidelines
* Company paid life insurance in accordance with plan guidelines
* 401k with employer match in accordance with plan guidelines
* 15 Days of PTO accrued annually, plus one additional day of PTO every year on your anniversary, and 3 Floating Holidays per year
* Paid beach and giveback days, bi\-annual team building events and other in\-person celebrations
* Work with talented and great people who share a love of Roark
* Dog friendly office

description:
**The SPLC is seeking a Program Manager, Center for Advocacy \& Learning who is passionate about social justice!**
==================================================================================================================



The Program Manager, Center for Advocacy and Learning will advance and lead the Alabama State Office community\-centered training, leadership development and education. This role will be responsible for designing the curriculum for our organizing and advocacy leadership programs. This role will localize advocacy and grassroots organizing workshops, facilitate trainings, and build out the train\-the\-trainer model that expands our capacity to develop leaders across Alabama.


### **Who You Are**


**Experienced** curriculum designer and adult learning practitioner with a passion for creating engaging, community\-centered learning experiences that build leadership, advocacy, and organizing skills.


**Research and Analytics.** You combine strong research and analytical skills with the ability to translate complex policy and legislative issues into accessible, actionable content that equips community members to understand and take action.


**Train the Trainer.** You are a skilled facilitator who understands not only how to deliver impactful trainings, but how to design curriculum and train\-the\-trainer programs that enable others to facilitate with confidence and consistency.


**Collaborative.** You are a highly collaborative relationship builder who enjoys partnering across teams and with community leaders, organizations, and subject matter experts to develop trainings that reflect local needs and strengthen community leadership.


**Organized and Adaptable.** You thrive in a fast\-paced environment, balancing multiple priorities while continuously improving programs based on participant feedback, data, and evolving organizational priorities.


**Mission, Vision \& Values Alignment**. Demonstrates an understanding of and a commitment to SPLC's mission, vision and values.


### **What You'll Do**


**Design**, develop, and continuously refine the Institute's organizing, advocacy, and leadership development curriculum, by adapting place\-based frameworks into accessible, culturally grounded learning experiences that address the needs and priorities of Alabama communities.


**Develop** and facilitate workshops, trainings, and leadership development opportunities for cohort members, community partners, and other stakeholders, using participant feedback and program outcomes to strengthen program effectiveness and impact.


**Build** and lead a train\-the\-trainer program by developing facilitation standards, tools, and materials that ensure consistent, high\-quality delivery while expanding the Institute's network of skilled trainers and facilitators.


**Identify**, recruit, coordinate, and support trainers, guest speakers, and subject matter experts who enhance Institute programming and contribute to participant learning and engagement.


**Lead** the recruitment, selection, onboarding, and ongoing engagement of cohort members, fostering a supportive learning environment and strengthening connections through the Institute's alumni network.


**Collaborate** with program leadership and internal departments to align Institute initiatives with organizational priorities while building and maintaining partnerships with community leaders, educators, organizations, cultural institutions, and coalition partners to strengthen community impact and local leadership development.


**Perform** other duties as required or assigned which are reasonably within the scope of the duties in this job classification.

* Minimum of 5 years of community education, program management, coalition and group facilitation, or related field, including direct experience designing curriculum or training programs; and

**About Pearson** At Pearson, we are committed to helping people make progress in their lives through learning. We create innovative and accessible educational products and services that foster personal and professional growth. We are looking for a passionate and skilled Product Director to join our team and drive the development of cutting\-edge educational products.


**About the Job** We embrace an SVPG\-inspired Product Operating Model, empowering our product teams to solve hard problems – customer problems and business problems – in ways that our customers love, yet work for our business. Product companies depend on strong products, and strong products come from strong product teams. And we recognise that product teams are only as strong as their product managers.


Success in this role requires marrying strong product management practices with deep understanding of the certification and workforce readiness ecosystem, including how skills validation, credentials, and assessment solutions create value for learners, educators, employers, and industry partners.


**Position Overview**

We're seeking an innovative and experienced Lead, Product Manager, to lead a high\-performing empowered product team responsible for delivering customer and business outcomes. This role is responsible for driving the customer product discovery and strategy of Pearson's Certiport portfolio, coach and develop product managers and continuously deliver to our learners, educators, academic institutions, workforce organizations, and technology industry partners through certification, assessment, and workforce readiness solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with product management acumen, product delivery excellence, and a coaching mindset to accelerate business value.


The successful candidate is responsible for the value and viability risks and is overall accountable for the Certiport Product outcomes. Ideal candidate combines strong product sense and management leadership with a deep understanding of certification, credentialing, assessment, workforce development, and education markets to identify opportunities that drive learner outcomes, customer value, and business growth.


**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy \& Vision


* Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to define and evolve product vision, strategy, and priorities.
* Translate company objectives into coherent product initiatives and outcome\-based roadmaps.
* Drive portfolio\-level prioritization based on customer value, business impact, and strategic alignment.
* Ensure product investments align with organizational goals and market opportunities.
* Champion customer\-centric decision making throughout the organization.

Product Discovery \& Innovation


* Establish strong product discovery practices across teams.
* Ensure teams continuously validate assumptions through customer research, experimentation, and data insights.
* Promote evidence\-based decision making over opinion\-based prioritization.
* Foster a culture of innovation, learning, and rapid iteration.
* Guide teams in identifying and solving high\-value customer problems.

Team Leadership \& Development


* Lead, mentor, and develop Product Managers.
* Create clear expectations, career paths, and growth opportunities for product talent.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct performance management, succession planning, and talent reviews.
* Recruit and retain exceptional product management talent.
* Coaches Product Managers to become skilled problem solvers.
* Creates empowered teams capable of making informed product decisions.

Cross\-Functional Leadership


* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Program to ensure product teams maintain strong product\-engineering\-design collaboration.
* Facilitate alignment across stakeholders (Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Customer Success leaders) while protecting team focus and autonomy.
* Influence executive and cross\-functional decisions through strong communication and product judgment.
* Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities to drive strategic outcomes.
* Communicate product vision, strategy, priorities, and outcomes effectively across executive, business, and technical audiences, building alignment and advocacy for strong product management practices.

Product Delivery \& Outcomes


* Ensure teams are focused on delivering measurable outcomes rather than feature output.
* Monitor portfolio health through customer, business, and product performance metrics.
* Remove organizational obstacles that limit team effectiveness.
* Establish operating mechanisms that improve speed, quality, and learning.
* Balance short\-term business needs with long\-term product strategy.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years product management experience, including leadership of multiple product teams.
* 5\+ years leading Product Managers and developing product talent.
* Proven experience defining product strategy and delivering measurable business results.
* Strong understanding of modern product management practices, including discovery, experimentation, and outcome\-based planning.
* Experience partnering with engineering and design leaders in an empowered product model.
* Demonstrated success influencing senior executives, communicating across business and technical stakeholders, and driving organizational alignment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading complex product portfolios across multiple customer segments.
* Background scaling product organizations through periods of growth or transformation
* Experience in SaaS, platform, digital, AI, data, or technology\-enabled products.
* Domain expertise in learning technologies and educational product development
* Strong analytical capabilities and systems thinking approach to complex technical challenges
* Preferred experience in one or more of the following:
* Professional certification, credentialing, or assessment programs
* Education technology, learning solutions, or workforce development products
* K\-12, higher education, career readiness, or workforce skills markets
* Developing products that serve educators, learners, employers, or industry certification sponsors
* Knowledge of emerging workforce skills, career pathways, digital credentials, and skills\-based hiring trends

**What** **You'll Love About This Role**

You’ll lead and empower a team of Product Managers responsible for creating learning and certification experiences that help millions of learners realize the life they imagine through learning. Your team will build products that enable educators to prepare students with in\-demand, industry\-recognized credentials, equipping them with the skills, confidence, and opportunities needed to succeed in higher education, launch meaningful careers, and thrive in an evolving workforce. You’ll create an environment where empowered product teams solve important customer problems, deliver measurable business outcomes, and shape the future of workforce readiness around the globe.
